360: Hahu mazzala denagid venafik veitchabbar behahu darga leishtallema beh uleitbarcha minneh, veal da kolla bemazzala talya milleta. veal da taninan, bani chayye umezone lav bizchuta talya milleta ella bemazzala talya milleta. deha bizchuta lav ihu ella ad deitmalleya veitnehir min mazzala.

Uvegin kach kol inun deittavru behay alma veinun zakkay keshot, kullehu ittavru behay alma veitdanu bedina. may tama, begin dehahi nafsha garma lehu, veal da chayis alayyhu kudesha berich hu lealma deate.

Ribbi elazar amar, kol ma deavid kudesha berich hu bedina ihu, begin ledakkaa lehahi nafsha leayytaa lah lealma deate. (uvegin kach kudesha berich hu kol ovadoy) (nusach acher begin dechol ovadoy dekudesha berich hu) inun bedina ukeshot. uvegin leaavara minneh hahu zuhama dekabbilat behay alma veal da ittavar hahu gufa veitdechiat nafsha. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu avid lehahu zakkaa deyisbol yissurin umachovin behay alma veyitneke mikkolla veyizke lechayye alma. veal da ketiv (Tehillim 11:5) Adonai tzaddik yivchan. vadday, veha ittemar.

Ribbi shimon patach, (Vayikra 21:23) ach el happarochet lo yavo veel hammizbeach lo yiggash ki mum bo velo yechallel et mikdashay ki ani Adonai mekaddesho. ach el happarochet lo yavo. ta chaze, behahi shata dehahu nahar denagid venafik appik kol inun nishmatin veitavarat nukeva, kullehu kayymin lego bekureta dilgo besito kureta.

Vechad sihara itpegim behahu sitra dechivya visha, keden kol inun nishmatin denafkin, af al gav dechullehu dachyayn vechullehu kaddishin, hoil venaflu bifgimu. bechol inun atre dematu inun nishmatin kullehu ittavru veitpegimu bechamma tzaarin bechamma keevin, veillen inun (nishmatin vaatareyn) (nusach acher nishmatin daatareyn difgimu) deitree behu kudesha berich hu levatar deittavru, veaf al gav denishmatin baatzivu vela bechedvavn.

Raza demilla sharyayn kegavvna dilela gufa itpegim, venishmata lego kegavvna dilela, vadday kegavvna deda, uvegin kach illen inun devayayn lechadtute bechadtuta desihara, veal illen ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbatto yavo chol basar lehishtachavot lefanay amar Adonai. kol basar vadday, deillen yitchadtun becholla. uvayayn lechadtute bechadtuta desihara.

Veillen inun beshuttafuta chada besihara pegimin behahu pegimu dilah, uvegin kach ihi sharya begavvavyyhu tadir dela shavka lon kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 57:15) veet dakka ushefal ruach. uchetiv, (tehillim la) karov Adonai lenishbere lev, leinun desavle im sihara hahu pegimu, inun kerevin lah tadir. veal da lehachayot lev nidkaim, beinun chayyim deatyayn lah leitchadta yehe lon chulekehon, inun desavle immah yitchadtun immah.

Veillen ikrun yissurin shel ahava, shel ahava inun vela minneh dehahu var nash. shel ahava, inun deitpaggim nehora shel ahava zuta deitdachyay meahava rabba. begin kach illen inun chaverim meshuttafim bahadah. zakkaa chulakhon bealma den uvealma deate, deinun zachu lehay lemehve chaverim bahadah, alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay vegomer.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 52:13) hinne yaskil avdi yarum venissa vegava meod. zakkaa chulakhon detzaddikayay dekudesha berich hu gale lon arche deorayyta lemehach behu. ta chaze, hay kera raza illaa ihu, hinne yaskil avdi veukemuha. aval ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, avad lah lesihara veazar lah nehoraha deha let lah migarmah kelum. uvegin deazirat garmah, itnahara begin shimsha, uvetukefa dinhorin illain.
Uvezimna dehava be makdesha kayyaym, yisrael havu mishtaddelin bekurebanin veillavavn ufulechanin, dehavu avdin kahani velevae veyisreele begin lekashra kishrin uleanhara nehorin.
Ulevatar deitcharav be makdesha itchashshach nehora, vesihara la itnehirat min shimsha, veshimsha
361: Istallak minnah vela itnehara, velet lach yoma dela shalta beh levavtin vetzaarin ucheevin kema deittemar.

Uvehahu zimna demte zimna desihara leitnahara, ma ketiv hinni yaskil avdi, aleh desihara ittemar hinne yaskil avdi da hu raza dimhemnuta. hinne yaskil, deitar itaruta leela keman dearach recha veate leitara uleistakkala. yarum, missitra dinhora illaa dechol nehorin.

Yarum, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 30:18) velachen yarum lerachemchem. venissa, missitra deavraham. vegava, missitra deyitzchak. meod, missitra deyaakov. veaf al gav deukemuha, vecholla chad beraza dechachmeta.

Uvehahu zimna yitar kudesha berich hu itaruta illaa leanhara lah lesihara kedka yeut kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim. uvegin kach yittosaf bah ruach illaa, uvegin kach yitarun keden kol inun metaya deinun go afra.

Veda hu avdi, raza demaftechan demareh bideh. kema deat amer, (el avdo zaken beto vechamma deat amar), (Bereshit 24:2) vayyomer avraham el avdo, da sihara kema deittemar, 314 deihu eved shelicha demareh.
Zekan beto kema deat amer, (Tehillim 37:25) naar hayiti gam zakanti. hammoshel bechol asher lo, begin dechol gevavnin itchazun beh yarok vechivvavr vesumak.

Sim na yadcha tachat yerechi, da hu tzaddik raza demilla, kiyyuma dealma. deha keden hay eved memanna beraza illaa laachayay lon ledayyre afra veyitavid shelicha berucha dilela velatava ruchin venishmatin leatrayyhu leinun gufe (sefer acher daataakalev) deitbalu veitrekavu techot afra.

Veashbiacha baAdonai elohe hashshamayim. veashbiacha, may veashbiacha. leitlabbesha beraza dishva nehorin illain deinun raza dishlimu illaa. asher lo tikkach ishsha, da hu gufa ditchot afra deit leh kiyyuma laakama meafra. dechol inun deitkevaru vah vezachu leitkevara beara deyisrael inun yitarun bekadmita, kema deokimna. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) yichyu metecha, bekadmita illen metin deara deyisrael. nevelati yekumun, inun metin dishar aran. veal da leinun gufehon deyisrael deitkevaru tamman, vela legufe dishar amin ovde avoda zara deistaava ara minayyhu.

Veal da asher lo tikkach ishsha livni. may livni. dechol nishmatin dealma denafke mehahu nahar denagid venafik, inun benin lekudesha berich hu. veal da asher lo tikkach ishsha, da gufa. livni, da nishmata. mibbenot hakkenaani, illen gufin deammin ovde avoda zara, dezammin kudesha berich hu lenaara lon meara kaddisha. kema deat amer, (Iyov 38:13) veyinnaaru reshaim mimmennah. keman dimnaer tallita mizzuhama dilah.

Ki el artzi veel moladti telech. artzi, da hi ara kaddisha deihu kadmaa lechol shear arin kema deittemar. (veal da ki el artzi da ara kaddisha deihu dileh ben kol shear arain defaleg lon limmannan acharanin) veal da ki el artzi, veel moladti. kevan deamar el artzi mahu veel moladti. ella el artzi kema deittemar, (mahu) veel moladti illen inun yisrael.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyikkach haeved kema deittemar. asara gemallim, illen inun asara dargin dehay eved shalta alayyhu, kegavvna dilela. miggemalle adonav, deinun kehahu gavvna mammash kema deittemar, vehay eved shalta veittakkan behu.
Vechol tuv adonav beyado, kol hahu tivu rechin illain denafke miggo inun nehorin uvotzinin illain. vechol tuv adonav, hahu shimmusha deshimsha deitmashshecha bah besihara.

Vayyakam vayyelech el aram naharayim, da atar deara kaddisha devachat tamman rachel kad chariv be makdesha. vayyavrech haggemallim michutz lair el beer hammayim, leittakfa chelaha betukefaha kedka yeut ad la tiul laakama lon leinun gofin.
Leet erev, may leet erev. da erev shabbat
362: Deihu zimna deelef shetitaa. leet erev kema deat amer (Tehillim 104:23) velaavodato ade arev uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 6:4) ki yinnatu tzillele arev.

Leet tzet hashshoavot, dehahu zimna zeminin lemekam velaachayay bekadmita mikkol shear bene alma, inun deshaave memoy deorayyta (vasheabeyn), begin deitasseku leshaava mimmeme deorayyta, veittakkafu beilana dechayye, veinun yifkun bekadmita, deilana dechayye garma lon dikumun bekadmita kema deittemar.

Uvenot anshe hair yotzot. may yotzot, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 26:19) veeretz refaim tappil, dezammina ara lemiflat minnah kol ruchin deinun begavvav, veal da ketiv yotzot. lishov mayim, lenatla nishmata ulekabbela lah kedka yeut metakna meatrah kedka chaze.

Vehaya hannaara asher omar eleha hatti na chaddech veeshte, begin deha ittemar, dechol inun nishmatin dealma deitkayymu behay alma veishtaddelu leminda lemarehon beraza dechachmeta illaa. ihi salkat veitkayymat bedarga illaa al kol inun dela itdabbeku vela yadu, veinun itkayymun bekadmita. veda hu sheelta dekaim hahu eved leminda ulemishal, bemma itassekat hahi nishmata behay alma.

Veamra elay gam atta shete, ant bae lemishte uleitshakya bekadmita, uvatrach vegam ligmallecha ashke. begin dechol inun shear retichin af al gav deitshakyayn mehay darga, kullehu itshakyayn mippulechana detzaddikayay deyade pulechana demarehon kedka yeut. detzaddikayay yade lesappeka lechol darga vedarga kedka yeut. veal da vegam ligmallecha ashke. vadday hi haishsha asher hochiach Adonai leven adoni. vadday hahi (sefer acher beitaruta ditzlota dili) ihu gufa deizdamman lehahi nishmata illaa.

Ta chaze, deha ittemar detiuveta didchura legabbe nukeva avid nishmata. vetiuveta denukeva legabbe dechura salka veitarav bahadah dilela veitkelil da beda veavid nishmata. uvegin kach hi haishsha. da hu gufa vadday deihu zemina lehahu reuta denishmata denafka min dechura.

Veinun gufin zeminin leatara bekadmita kidamaran. ulevatar deillen yekumun, yekumun kol ochoranin devishar aran, veyitkayymun bekiyyuma shelim, veyitchadtun bechadtuta desihara, veyitchaddesh alma kemilkaddemin. ucheden ketiv behahu zimna (Tehillim 104:31) yismach Adonai bemaasav.
Uvegin kach (Yeshayahu 52:13) hinne yaskil avdi, leahadara nishmatin kol chad vechad leatreh. yarum venissa vegava meod, missitra dechol inun dargin illain kidkaamaran.

(Yeshayahu 52:14) kaasher shammu alecha rabbim ken mishchat meish marehu vetoaro mibbene adam. ta chaze, deha ittemar dechad itcharav be makdesha, ushechinta (itgeli) bego aran nucherain benayyhu. ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erelam tzaaku chutza malache shalom mar yivkayun. kullehu bachu al da, ukeshiru bechiya veevla. vechol da ala dishchinta deitgalleyay meatrah, vechamma deihi mishtannet mikkema dehavat. uf hachi baalah la nahir nehoreh veishtanne mikkema dehava, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 13:10) chashach hashshemesh betzeto. veal da ketiv ken mishchat meish marehu.

Davar acher ken mishchat meish marehu, mehay eved deishtanni diukeneh ugevavneh mikkema dehava. davar acher ken mishchat meish marehu, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 50:3) albish shamayim kadrut vesak asim kesutam. deha miyyoma deitcharav be makdesha la kayymu shamayim binhora dilhon, veraza demilla birchan la sharyayn ella beatar deishtakkachu dechar venukeva, veukemuha. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2) zachar unekeva beraam vayvarech otam. uvegin kach mishchat meish marehu.
Veda hu kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad, avud o neevad lo neemar, ella avad, dela sharyayn birchan ella beatar deishtakkachu dechar venukeva kechada kema deittemar.
Begin da behahu zimna dela ishtakkach
363: Dechura bahadah, ucheden kol inun nishmatin denafke kullehu have lehu shinnuya mikkema dehavu bezimna deshimsha itchabbar besihara kema deittemar. veal da elle toldot yaakov yosef vegomer veittemar.
Vehu naar, begin dela mitparshin lealmin, tzaddik vetzedek kechada inun, kema deihi itkeriat bishma didchura, hachi name itkere ihu bishma dilah dichtiv vehu naar.
Et bene bilha veet beni zilpa, bechullehu kayyma lechadta lon kedka yeut uleishtashea lon bechedva dileh. dechullehu anfin vechullehu alin, kullehu itbarchin bechedva dileh.

Elle toldot yaakov yosef, kema deittemar dechol diukena deyaakov hava beh beyosef, vechol ma deera lehay era lehay, vetarvavyyhu kechada azle. veda hu raza deat 12 deazle tarvavyyhu kechada, begin deinun raza chada vediukena chada:

Vayyave yosef et dibbatam raa, ha ukemuha dehava amar leavoy alayyhu dehavu achle shayyfa mibbaale chayyin kad inun chayyin. vayyave yosef et dibbatam raa, vechi ha beminyayna havu inun bene shefachot, hech havu mezalzelin behon bene lea, vehech havu achlin evar min hachay vehavu avrin al pikkuda demarehon. deha pakkid al bene noach pikkuda da. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 9:4) ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu, veinun havu achle leh veavrin al pikkuda demarehon. ella yosef hava kaamar, veal da itannash.
Ribbi yehuda amar, et dibbatam raa, kema deukemuha deyahave enayyhu bivnot ara, veda hu dibbatam raa. leyanka lechol inun dargin dela kaddishin (davar acher 33 af al gav) deatyayn missitra mesaava:

Veyisrael ahav et yosef mikkol banav ki ven zekunim hu lo veasa lo ketonet passim. ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 26:20) lech ammi bo vachadarecha usegor delatcha baadecha chavi chimat rega ad yaavar zaam. lech ammi bo vachadarecha. ta chaze, kamma kudesha berich hu rachim lon leyisrael. uvegin rechimuta dilhon derachim lon al kol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, azhar lon, uvae lenatra lon bechol ma deinun avdin.
Ta chaze, telat zimnin it beyoma dedina sharya bealma, vechad ate hahu zimna, mibbae leh levar nash leizdahara uleistamra dela yifga beh hahu dina, veinun zimnin yedian veha ukemuha.

Begin deha kad salik tzafra, avraham itar bealma, veachid leh ledina lekashra leh bahadeh. uvesheruta ditlat shae kammayyta natil dina meatrih leatara beh beyaakov, ad deitar tzelota demincha deahadar dina leatreh, veitar dina diltatta leitkashshera bedina dilela. deha keden itkashshar dina bedina uvae leizdahara.

(Leel sach 2) tu kad dina itar bealma umota ishtakkach bemata, la libbae leh levar nash lemehach yechiday beshuka veha okimna mille. ella bae leasgara garmeh dela yippuk levar, kema deukemuha benoach deasgar garmeh betevuta dela yishtakkach kame mechabbela.

Veal da lech ammi bo vachadarecha, asgar garmach. usegor delatcha baadecha, dela yitchaze kammeh dimchabbela. chavi kimat rega ad yaavor zaam, devatar deaavar dina let leh reshu limchabbela lechabbala.

Ta chaze, dekudesha berich hu, begin rechimuta deihu rachim lon leyisrael vekariv lon legabbeh, kol shear ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot sanin lon leyisrael. begin deinun mitrachakin veyisrael kerevin.

Veta chaze, begin rechimuta derachim yaakov leyosef yattir meachoy, af al gav dechullehu havu leh achin, ma ketiv vayyitnakkelu oto lahamito, kol shekken ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot leyisrael.
Ta chaze, kamma garim leh hahu rechimuta derachim leh yattir, degaram leh deitgele meavoy, veitgeli avoy bahadeh, vegaram lehu galuta
364: Velishchinta deitgalleya benayyhu. veaf al gav deitgezirat gezera, veukemuha divgin ketonet passim deavad leh yattir, ma ketiv vayyiru echav:

Vayyachalom yosef chalom vegomer, ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Bamidbar 12:6) vayyomer shimu na devaray im yihye neviachem Adonai bammara elav etvadda bachalom adabber bo. ta chaze, kamma dargin ledargin avad kudesha berich hu, vechullehu kayyme da al da. darga al darga, da leel min da, vechullehu yankin illen min illen kedka chaze lon, illen mimina veillen missemala, vechullehu itmannan illen al illen, kolla kedka yeut.

Ta chaze, kol nevie dealma kullehu yanke missitra chada, miggo terin dargin yedian, veinun dargin havu itchazzeyayn bego aspaklarya dela nahara, dichtiv bammara elav etvadda, may hu mara, kema deittemar (davar acher 33 demara) chezu dechol gevavnin itchazzeyayn begavvav, veda hi aspaklarya dela nahara. bachalom adabber bo, da hu chad mishshittin binvua kema deukemuha. veihu darga shetitaa mehahu darga dinvua veihu (196 1) darga degavriel dimmanna al chelma veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, kol chelma deihu kedka yeut mehay darga ka atya, veal da let lach chelma dela yitarvun immeh millin kedivin, kema deokimna, uvegin kach minnayyhu keshot uminnayyhu kedivan, velet lach chelma dela it beh mehay gisa umehay gisa.

Uvegin deit beh bechelma kolla kidamaran, kol chelmin dealma azlin batar pishra defuma, veukemuha. dichtiv, (Bereshit 41:13) vayhi kaasher patar lanu ken haya. may tama, begin deit beh bechelma kedivu ukeshot, umilla shalta al kolla, uvegin kach bae chelma pishra tava. ribbi yehuda amar, begin dechol chelma middarga diltatta ihu, vedibbur shalta aleh. uvegin kach kol chelma azla batar pishra.

Patach veamar, (Iyov 33:15-16) bachalom chezyon layla binfol tardema al anashim bitnumot ale mishkav az yigle ozen anashim uvemosaram yachtom. ta chaze, kad salik bar nash learseh, mibbae leh leamlacha aleh malchuta dishmaya bekadmita, ulevatar yema chad pesuka derachame veukemuha chavrayay. begin deha kad bar nash naim al arseh, ha nishmateh nafka minnih veazla veshatya leela, kol chad vechad kefum archeh vehachi selikat kema deittemar.

Ma ketiv, bachalom chezyon layla. kad bene nasha shachve bearsayyhu nayymin venishmata nafkat minnayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, bitnumot ale mishkav az yigle ozen anashim. ucheden kudesha berich hu oda lah lenishmata behahu darga dekayyma al chelma, inun millin dizminin lemete al alma o inun millin kefum inun hirhurin delibbeh. begin devar nash natil archa detochache dealma.

Begin deha la modain leh levar nash beod deihu kaim betukefa degufa (nusach acher derucha) kidkaamaran, ella malacha oda lenishmata venishmata levar nash. vehahu chelma ihu milleela, kad nishmatin nafkin miggufe vesalkin kol chad vechad kefum archeh.
Vechamma dargin al dargin, beraza dechelma kullehu beraza dechachmeta. veta chaze, chalom darga chada, mara darga chada, nevua darga chada, vechullehu dargin ledargin illen al illen.

Vayyachalom yosef chalom vayyagged leechav vayyosifu od seno oto al chalomotav. mehacha dela mibbae leh levar nash lememar chelmeh bar lehahu bar nash derachim leh, vei lav, ihu garim leh. dei hahu chelma mithappech legavvna ochora, ihu garim lesalleka.

Ta chaze, deyosef ihu amar chelma laachuhi, veal da garmu leh lesallaka chelmeh teren veesrin shenin deitakkav. ribbi yose amar, menalan, dichtiv vayyosifu od seno oto. may seno oto, degarmu leh kitrugin beda.
Ma ketiv, vayyomer alehem shimu na hachalom hazze
365: Asher chalamti, devaa minayyhu deyishmeun leh. veihu oda lehu hahu chelma, deilmale inun deahafachu leh legavvna ochora, hachi itkeyyaym. veinun ativu veamru hamaloch timloch alenu im mashol timshol banu. miyyad amru leh pishra dechalma vegazru gezera, uvegin kach vayyosifu od seno oto.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havu shechiche kameh deribbi shimon, amar ribbi chiyyay, ha taninan chelma dela itpashshar, keiggarta dela mitkarya. i begin deitkeyyaym veihu la yada, o dela itkeyyaym kelal. amar leh, itkeyyaym vela ityeyda, deha hahu chelma chela talya aleh, veihu la ityeda vela yedia, i itkeyyaym i la itkeyyaym.

Velet lach milla bealma dead la yete lealma, delav ihi talyay bechelma o al yeda decharoza. deha ittemar dechol milla umilla ad la yete lealma, machreze aleh barakia. umittamman itpashshat bealma veityehiv al yeda decharoza. vecholla begin dichtiv, (Amos 3:7) ki lo yaase Adonai elohim davar ki im gala sodo el avadav hanneviim, bezimna dinviim ishtakkachu bealma. vei lav, af al gav dinvua la sharya, chakkime adife minneviim. vei la, ityehiv bechelma. vei lav, betzippore shemaya mishtakkeche milla veha ukemuha:

Vayyelchu echav lirot et tzon avihem bishchem. ribbi shimon amar, lirot tzon avihem mibbae leh, may et nakud milleela, leasgaa imhon shechinta, deihi immehon sharyay. begin deinun havu asara, deha yosef la hava immehon, uvinyamin ihu zeir beveta. uvegin kach inun havu asara. vechad azlu havat shechinta benayyhu, veal da nakud milleela.
Uvegin kach bezimna dezabbinu leh leyosef ishtattafu kullehu bahade shechinta veashtifu lah bahadayyhu kad avidu omaa. vead deitgalleyay milla deyosef, la sharya shechinta aleh deyaakov.

Vei tema dishchinta la ishtakkechat immehon. ta chaze, dichtiv (Tehillim 122:4) sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah edut leyisrael lehodot leshem Adonai. kullehu tzaddike vachaside kiyyuma dechol alma, kiyyuma inun leela vetatta.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 122:1) samachti beomrim li bet Adonai nilech. hay kera ukemuha, dedavid hava im libbeh lemivne beta. kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 8:17) vayhi im levav david avi livnot bayit leshem Adonai vegomer. ulevatar ma ketiv rak atta lo tivne habbayit ki im bincha hayyotze mechalatzecha hu yivne habbayit lishmi. vechol yisrael havu yade da, vehavu amru ematay yamut david veyakum shelomo bereh veyivne beta. ucheden omdot hayu raglenu bisharayich yerushalayim, keden nisak venakriv tamman karbanin.

Veim kol da, af al gav dehavu amru ematay yamut sava da, keden samachti. vechedva hava li begin beri, dehavu amre divri yakum techoti lemigmar pikuda lemivni veta. keden share veshabbach lah veamar, yerushalayim habbenuya keir shechubbera lah yachdav.

Tenan avad kudesha berich hu yerushalayim letatta kegavvna dilela, veda mittakkena (da) lokovel da dichtiv, (Shemot 15:17) machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai. habbenuya, dezammin kudesha berich hu lenachata lah yerushalayim dilela kedka yaot, uvegin kach habbenuya. shechubbera lah yachdav, veha ukemuha shechubbera shechibberu mibbae leh. ella deitchabbarat imma bivratta vehavu kechada veukemuha.

Veittemar. sheshsham alu shevatim illen inun kiyyuma dealma vetikkuna dealma tattaa, vela tema dealma tattaa bilchodoy, ella afillu dealma illaa. dichtiv shivte yah edut leyisrael, leyisrael dayyka. begin deinun kiyyuma letatta, sahaduta inun leela. vecholla lehodot leshem Adonai, leodaa shemeh dekudesha berich hu lechol sitrin, dichtiv lehodot leshem Adonai:
Vayyimtzaehu ish vehinne toe bassade vayyishalehu haish lemor ma tevakkesh.
366: Ma ketiv leela, vayyomer yisrael el yosef halo achecha roim bishchem lecha veeshlachacha alehem. vechi yaakov shelema dehava rachim leh leyosef mikkol benoy, vehava yada dechol achuy havu sanin leh, ammay shaddar leh legabbayyhu. ella ihu la chashid alayyhu, dehava yada dechullehu havu zakkain, vela chashid lon. ella garim kudesha berich hu kol da, begin lekayyma gezera degazar ben habbetarim.

Ashkachna besifre kadmay, devayayn illen bene yaakov leshalletaa aloy ad la yechot lemitzrayim. deillu hu yechot lemitzrayim, veinun la shaltu beh bekadmita. yachle mitzrai leshalletaa lealmin alayyhu deyisrael, veitkayyma beh beyosef deizdabban leavda veinun shaltu aloy. veaf al gav deyosef hava malka levatar, umitzrae havu avdin leh, ishtakkachu yisrael deshaltu al kullehu.

Ta chaze, deyosef deihu berit ilaa, kol zimna deitkeyyaym berit, shechinta itkeyyaym bahadayyhu deyisrael bishlam kedka yeut, kevan deistallak yosef berit illaa mealma, keden berit shechinta veyisrael kullehu begaluta nafku, veha okimna dichtiv (Shemot 1:8) vayyakam melech chadash al mitzrayim asher lo yada et yosef. vecholla hava meim kudesha berich hu kedka yeut.

Ta chaze, vayyimtzaehu ish da gavriel, veukemuha. ketiv hacha vayyimtzaehu ish, uchetiv hatam (Daniel 9:21) vehaish gavriel asher raiti vechazon battechilla. vehinne toe, becholla toe, deavtach al achuy dehava mitba achva dilhon vela ashkach, vetava lehu vela ashkach. veal da toe becholla, veal da vayyishalehu haish lemor ma tevakkesh:

Vayyomer et achay anochi mevakkesh vegomer. vayyomer haish nasu mizze vegomer, ribbi yehuda patach, (Shir HaShirim 8:1) mi yittencha keach li yonek shede immi emtzaacha vachutz eshakcha gam lo yavozu li. hay kera ukemuha chavrayay, aval hay kera keneset yisrael amaro lemalka dishlama dileh. mi yittencha keach li, keyosef al achuy, deamar, (Bereshit 50:21) veatta al tirau anochi achalkel etchem veet tappechem. yahav lon mezona vezan lehu bechafna. begin kach mi yittencha keach li.

Davar acher mi yittencha keach li, da yosef, legabbah dishchinta deitachad immah veitdabbak bahadah. yonek shede immi, deha keden achva ushelimu bahadayyhu. emtzaacha bachutz, go galuta, deihu beara ochora. eshakcha, begin leitdabbeka rucha berucha. gam lo yavozu li, af al gav deana beara ochora.

Ta chaze, deyosef af al gav deachoy la havu leh keachin kad nafal bidayyhu. ihu hava lon keacha kad naflu bideh, veha ukemuha. dichtiv, (Bereshit 50:21) vaynachem otam vaydabber al libbam, becholla dibber al libbayyhu.

Veta chaze, ma ketiv vayyomru ish el achiv, da shimon velevi deinun havu achin vadday becholla, begin deka atu missitra dedina kashya. uvegin kach rugeza dilhon, ihu rugeza diktala bealma. kema deat amer (Bereshit 49:7) arur appam ki az veevratam ki kashata.

Ta chaze, raza demilla, it rugeza veit rugeza. it rugeza deihu mevarcha meela umittatta, veikre baruch, kema deittemar dichtiv (Bereshit 14:19) baruch avram leel elyon koni shamayim vaaretz veha ukemuha. veit rugeza deihi itlatya leela vetatta, kema deittemar deikre arur. dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:14) arur atta mikkol habbehema umikkol chayyat hassade. arur appam ki az.

Veal raza da it teren turin dichtiv, (Devarim 11:29) venatatta et habberacha al har gerizim veet hakkelala al har eval, lokovel illen teren dargin. veal da, da ikre arur, veda ikre baruch. veshimon velevi inun missitra dedina kashya, umin sitra dedina kashya takkifa, nafkat rugeza deitlatya.
Veta chaze, missitra dedina kashya nafke rugeza litre sitrin, chad deitbarach, vechad deitlatya.
367: Chad baruch vechad arur. kegavvna da missitra deyitzchak nafku teren benin, chad mevorach, vechad deitlatya leela vetatta. da itparash lesitreh, veda itparash lesitreh. da diyyureh beara kaddisha, veda diyyureh betura deseir. dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:27) ish yodea tzayid ish sade. da atreh beatar demidbara vecharva ushemama, veda yoshev ohalim. vecholla kegavvna deitzterich.

Uvegin kach teren dargin inun, baruch vearur, da lesitreh veda lesitreh. mehay nafkin kol birchan dealmin leela vetatta vechol tivu vechol nehiru vechol purekan vechol shezavuta. umehay nafkin kol levavtin vechol charba vechol dama vechol shemama vechol bishin vechol mesaavu dealma.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Tehillim 26:6) erchatz benikkayon kappay vaasovva et mizbachacha Adonai, hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, raza demilla hacha, deha let lach bar nash bealma dela taim tama demota belelya, veruach mesaava sharya al hahu gufa. may tama, begin denishmata kaddisha istallekat minneh devar nash, venafkat minneh. veal denishmata kaddisha nafkat veistallekat minnih, sharya rucha mesaava al hahu gufa veistaav.

Vechad nishmata ithadderat legufa, itavar hahu zuhama. veha ittemar didoy devar nash zuhama dimsaavu ishtaar behu. veal da la yaavar yedoy al enoy, begin dehahu ruach mesaava shary aloy, ad denatil lon. vechad natil yedoy kedka chaze, keden itk3dosh veikre kadosh.

Vehecha bae leitkaddesha. bae chad keli letatta vechad keli milleela, begin deyitkaddash mehahu dilela. vehahu diltatta deyativ bezuhama dimsaavu beh. veda keli lekabbela mesaavu, veda leitkaddesha minneh, da baruch veda arur. vela bayayn inun mayin dezuhama leoshda lon beveta, dela yikrav behu bar nash. deha behu mitkanneshe sitra dilhon, yachil lekabbela nizka meinun mayin mesaavin.

Vead deyitavar zuhama min yedoy la yevarech, veokimna. uvegin kach, bar nash ad la yekaddesh yedoy betzafra, ikre tame. kevan deitkaddash ikre tahor. uvegin kach la yittol ella min yeda deidke bekadmita. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 19:19) vehizza hattahor al hattame. da ikre tahor, veda ikre tame.

Begin kach chad keli leela vechad keli letatta, da kaddisha veda mesaava. umeinun mayin asir lemebad behu midi, ella bae leoshda lon beatar divne nasha la avrin alayyhu, vela yavit lon beveta. deha kevan deittoshdan beara, rucha mesaava ishtakkach tamman veyachil lenazka. vei chafar lon midron techot ara dela yitchazun shappir.

Vela yahiv lon linshe chorashaya deyichlun leavasha behu livni nasha. begin deinun mayin deitlatyayn, vekudesha berich hu bae ledakkaa lon leyisrael ulemeheve kaddishin. dichtiv, (Yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem mikkol tumotechem umikkol gillulechem ataher etchem:

Vayyikkachuhu vayyashlichu oto habbora vehabbor rek en bo mayim. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 19:8) torat Adonai temima meshivat nafesh (man devatil mile deorayyta keillu chariv alma shelim). kamma it lon livne nasha leishtaddela beorayyta, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta lehve leh chayyim bealma den uvealma deate, vezache bitren almin. veafillu man deishtaddal beorayyta vela yishtaddal bah lishmah kedka yaot, zache leagar tav bealma den, vela dayynin leh behahu alma.

Veta chaze, ketiv, (Mishlei 3:16) orech yamim biminah bismolah osher vechavod. orech yamim behahu deishtaddal beorayyta lishmah, deit leh orech yamim behahu alma deveh orcha deyomin. veinun yomin inun yomin vadday, tamman ihu rachatzanu dikdusha dilela deitrechitz bar nash behay alma leishtaddela beorayyta, leittakkefa behahu alma
368: Bismolah osher vechavod, agar tav veshalva it leh behay alma.

Vechol man deyishtaddal beorayyta lishmah, kad nafik mehay alma, orayyta azla kammeh veachrazat kammeh veaginat aleh, dela yikrevun bahadeh marehon dedina. kad shachiv gufa bekivra, hi natrat leh. kad nishmata azla leistalleka lemetav leatrah, ihi azla kammah dehahi nishmata. vechamma tarin ittavru mikkammah deorayyta ad dealat leduchetah. vekayyma aleh devar nash ad deyitar bezimna dikumun metayay dealma, veihi malfa sannegora aleh.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 6:22) behithallechcha tanche otach beshachbecha tishmor alecha vahakitzota hi tesichecha. behithallechcha tanche otach, kema deittemar. beshachbecha tishmor alecha, beshata deshachiv gufa bekivra, deha keden behahu zimna itdan gufa bekivra ucheden orayyta aginat aleh. vahakitzota hi tesichecha kema deittemar bezimna deyitarun mete alma min afra. hi tesichecha lemeheve sannegorya alach.

Ribbi elazar amar, hi tesichecha. may hi tesichecha. begin deaf al gav dehashta yekumun meafra, orayyta la yitneshe minnehon. deha keden yindeun kol hahi orayyta deshavku kad istalku mehay alma, hahi orayyta netira mehahu zimna vetiul bemeayyhu kemillekaddemin veihi temallel bemeayyhu.

Vechol millin mittakkenan yattir mikkema dehavu bekadmita, deha kol inun millin deihu la yachil leadbaka lo kedka yaot veihu ishtaddal behu vela itdabbak behu. kullehu alin bemeoy mittaknan, veorayyta temallel beh. hada hu dichtiv vahakitzota hi tesichecha. ribbi yehuda amar, kegavvna da kol man deishtaddal beorayyta behay alma, zache leishtaddela bah lealma deate veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, hahu var nash dela zache leishtaddela behay alma beorayyta, veihu azil bechashocha, kad nafik mehay alma, natlin leh vealin leh laggehinnom, atar tattaa dela yehe merachem aleh, deikre bor shaon tit hayyaven. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 40:3) vayyaaleni mibbor shaon mittit hayyaven vayyakem al sela raglay konen ashuray.

Ubbegin kach hahu dela ishtaddal beorayyta behay alma veittannaf betinnufe alma, ma ketiv vayyikkachuhu vayyashlichu oto habbora. da hu gehinnom, atar dedayynin lehu leinun dela ishtaddelu beorayyta. vehabbor rek, kema deihu hava rek. may tama begin dela hava beh mayim.

Veta chaze, kamma hu onsha deorayyta, deha la itgalu yisrael meara kaddisha, ella begin deistallaku meorayyta, veishtevaku minah. hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 9:11) mi haish hechacham veyaven et zot vegomer al ma avda haaretz vegomer. vayyomer Adonai al azvam et torati vegomer. ribbi yose amar, mehacha, (Yeshayahu Adonai:13) lachen gala ammi mibbeli daat.

Begin kach kolla kayyma al kiyyuma deorayyta, vealma la itkeyyaym bekiyyumeh ella beorayyta, deihu kiyyuma dealmin ela vetatta dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti:

Vayyikkachuhu vayyashlichu oto habbora, ramaz al dearmiu leh lego mitzrae atar dela ishtakkach raza dimhemnuta kelal. ribbi yitzchak amar, i nechashin veakrabbin havu beh, ammay ketiv biruven lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam lahashivo el aviv. vechi la chayyish reuven lehay. deha inun nechashin veakrabbin yenazkun leh, veech amar lahashivo el aviv, uchetiv lemaan hatztzil oto.

Ella chama reuven denizka ishtakkach bidayyhu deachoy, begin deyada kamma sanin leh ureuta dilhon lekatla leh. amar reuven, tav leminpal leh lego gova dinchashin veakrabbin, vela yitmesar bida desanoy dela merachame aleh. mikkan amru yappil var nash garmeh leesha o leguva dinchashin veakrabbin, vela yitmassar bida desanoy (dizirin inun daykaley leishtezava. uvegin kach amar lemaan hitztzil oto miyyadam).
369: Begin dehacha atar dinchashim veakrabbim. i ihu tzaddika, kudesha berich hu yarchish leh nisa. ulezimnin dizchu deavahan mesayyin leh levar nash veyishteziv minnayyhu. aval kevan deyitmassar bida desanoy, zeirin inun deyachlin leishtezava.

Uvegin kach amar, lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam. miyyadam dayyka, vela ketiv lemaan hatztzil oto vetu la. ella amar reuven, yishteziv min yedayyhu, vei yemut beguva yemut. uvegin kach ketiv vayyishma reuven vayyatztzilehu miyyadam.

Ta chaze, kamma chasiduteh diruven, divgin deyada deshimon velevi shuttefuta vachachimuta vechavruta dilhon, kashya inun. dechad itchabbaru bishchem, katlu kol dechura (sefer acher 33 veha dekatlu kol dechura) la day lon. ella denatlin nashin vataf vechaspa vedahava vechol beire vechol mane dikar vechol man deishtakkach bekarta. vela day kol da, ella deafillu kol ma divchakla natlu. dichtiv, (Bereshit la) veet asher bair veet asher bassade lakachu.

Amar, uma karta rabbata ki hay la ishteziv minnehon, ilmale ravya da yippol bidayyhu, la yasharun minneh umetza bealma. veal da amar, tav leishtezava minnayyhu dela yasharun minneh ishtaaruta bealma, vela yechome abba minneh kelum lealmin.

Vehacha i yemut, la yachlin leh veyishtaar kol gufeh shelim, vaativ leh leabba shelim. veal da lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam lahashivo el aviv, af al gav dimut hatam. uvegin kach amar hayyeled enennu. vela amar ennnu chay, ella amar enennu, afillu met.

Ta chaze, may deavad, deihu bechachmeta hava shattif garmeh bahadayyhu, dichtiv lo nakkennu nafesh, vela ketiv la takkuhu. veihu la hava tamman kad izdabban yosef, deha kullehu meshammeshe laavuhon kol chad vechad yoma chad. vehahu yoma diruven hava. veal da baa divhahu yoma dehava shimmusha dileh la yitavid yosef. uvegin kach ketiv vayyashav reuven el habbor vehinne en yosef babbor vayyikra et begadav. vehine en yosef dayyka. afillu (chay o) mit, miyyad vayyashav el echav vayyomer hayyeled enennu.
Veafillu reuven la yada mehahu zevina deyosef, veha ukemuha deishtattif behu shechinta, veal da la yada reuven mehahu zevina deyosef vela itgalyay leh ad hahu zimna deitgele yosef laachohi.

Ta chaze, kamma garim leh liruven begin deihu ishtaddal leachayay leh leyosef, ma ketiv, (Devarim 33:6) yechi reuven veal yamot vegomer. deha begin da, af al gav deyada deishtekil becheruteh minneh veityehiv leyosef, ishtaddal leachayay leh, vetzalle moshe veamar yechi reuven veal yamot, veitkeyyaym bealma den veitkeyyaym bealma deate. may tama, begin da, uvegin deavad teshuva mehahu ovada. dechol man deavid teshuva, kudesha berich hu kayyaym leh bealma den uvealma deate.

Ta chaze ma ketiv, vayyikchu et ketonet yosef vegomer, ha ukemuha divgin dedama desair damya ledama devar nash. aval ta chaze, af al gav demilla atya kedka chaze, kudesha berich hu medakdek behu betzaddikayay afillu kechut hassaara.

Yaakov avad ovada kedka yaot. bemay, begin deakriv legabboy avoy sair, deihu sitra dedina kashya. veim kol da, begin deihu akriv sair veakkechish leh leavoy deihu sitra dileh, itanash behay sair ochora, deakrivu leh benoy dama dileh.

Beihu ketiv, (Bereshit 27:16) veet orot gedaye haizzim hilbisha al yadav veal chelkat tzavvarav, begin kach vayyitbelu et hakkuttonet baddam, akrivu leh kuttonta leakkechasha leh, vecholla da lokovel da, ihu garim dichtiv vayyechorad yitzchak charada gedola ad meod, begin kach garmu leh decharad charada behahu zimna dichtiv hakker na hakketonet bincha hi im lo.
370: Ribbi chiyyay amar, beh ketiv, (Bereshit 27:21) haatta ze beni esav im lo. leh ketiv, hakketonet bincha hi im lo. ubbegin kach kudesha berich hu medakdek behu betzaddikaya bechol ma deinun avdin.

Ribbi abba amar, (nusach acher ameraz rabbi abba) kevan dechamu kullehu shivtin hahu tzaara deavuhon, itnechamu vavday, vihivu garmayyhu aleh deyosef, deyifdun leh ilmale yishkechun leh. kevan dechamu dela yachilu, ahadaru legabbeh dihuda veaavaru leh mealayyhu, begin deihu hava malka alayyhu. (ucheden sefer acher vechevan 4) aavaruhu mealayyhu, ma ketiv, vayhi baet hahi vayyered yehuda vegomer.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 18:14) vayyarem bashshamayim Adonai veelyon yitten kolo barad vegachale esh. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, atkin leh shiva semachin al ma dekayyma, vechullehu semachin kayyme bechad samcha yechiday, veha ukemuha. dichtiv, (Mishlei 9:1) chachmot nashim banta vetah chatzva ammudeha shiva. veillen kullehu inun kayyme bechad darga minnayyhu deikre (Mishlei 10:25) tzaddik yesod olam.

Vealma kad itbere, mehahu atar itbere. deihu shichlula dealma, vetikkunoy. deihu chad nekuda dealma, veemtzaita decholla. uman ihu, tziyyon. dichtiv, (Tehillim 50:1) mizmor leasaf el elohim Adonai dibber vayyikra eretz mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo. umean atar, mitztziyyon, dichtiv mitztziyyon michlal yofi elohim hofia. mehahu atar deihu sitra deshichlula dimhemnuta shelemata kedka yeut (vehasheta 1 yisrael ittakkafu beh beraze defikude deorayyta begin dechol yoma veyoma ittakkaf bar nash betzitzit daataataf beh). vetziyyon takkifu unekuda dechol alma, umehahu atar ishtachlal kol alma veitavid, umiggavveh kol alma ittezan.

Veta chaze, vayyarem bashshamayim Adonai veelyon yitten kolo vegomer, kevan deamar vayyarem bashshamayim Adonai, ammay ketiv veelyon yitten kolo. ha (sefer acher ella) hacha raza dimhemnuta, (veal ma sefer acher alma) deamina detziyyon ihu shichlula veshappiru dealma, vealma minneh ittezan. begin ditren dargin inun veinun chad, inun tziyyon viyrushalam. da dina veda rachame, vetarvayyhu chad, mehacha dina umehacha rachame.

Meela leela nafka kol deishtema, levatar dehahu kol nafka veishtema nafke dinin vearche dedina, verachame nafkin umitparshan mittamman. vayyarem bashshamayim Adonai, da be dina berachame. veelyon, af al gav dela ishtakkach vela ityeyda, kevan dehahu kol nafik keden ishtakkach kolla, dina verachame. hada hu dichtiv veelyon yitten kolo, kevan deyitten kolo, keden barad vegachale esh, maya veesha.

Ta chaze, beshata deityelid yehuda ma ketiv, (Bereshit 29) vattaamod milledet, begin deda hu yesoda reviaa meinun arba deinun reticha illaa, samcha chad meinun arba samchin. ma ketiv beh, vayhi baet hahi vayyered yehuda meet echav, dehava malka alayyhu. may tama, begin deyosef nachatu leh lemitzrayim kidkaamaran:

Vayyar sham yehuda bat ish kenaani. vechi kenaani hava, ella ha ukemuha chavrayyay. vattahar vatteled ben vayyikra et shemo er, telat benin havu leh lihuda, vela ishtaaru minnayyhu bar chad, veda hu shela.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yose veribbi chiyyay havu azle bearcha. amar ribbi yose leribbi elazar, ammay ketiv bivnoy dihuda, bekadmaa vayyikra et shemo er, uvitren ochoranin ketiv vattikra et shemo onan, vattikra et shemo shela.

Amar leh ta chaze, hay parshata raza illaa ihu, vecholla ihu kedka chaze. vayyered yehuda meet echav, deha itkasya sihara, venachatat middarga detikkunna lego darga ochara, deitchabbar beh chivveya, kema deat amer vayyet ad ish adullami ushemo chira.
Vattahar vatteled ben vayyikra et shemo er, veihu ra, vecholla chad, deatya missitra deyetzer hara. uvegin kach ketiv vayyikra et shemo, vela ketiv vayyikra shemo.
371: Beyaakov ketiv vayyikra shemo, dekudesha berich hu kara leh yaakov. vehacha et leasgaa darga ochora dezuhama dimsaava ityelid, veda hu er ra, vecholla chad.

Levatar la itbassam atra, ad deata shela dehava ikkara dechullehu. ma ketiv vayhi er bechor yehuda ra beeni Adonai, ketiv hacha ra, uchetiv hatam (bareasheytech) ki yetzer lev haadam ra minurav, ra deoshid damin, oshid zara al ara. uvegin kach vaymitehu Adonai. ma ketiv batreh, vayyomer yehuda leonan bo el eshet achicha vegomer:

Vayyomer yehuda leonan bo el eshet achicha vegomer. ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 41:25) hairoti mitztzafon vayyaat mimmizrach shemesh yikra vishmi veyavo seganim kemo chomer uchemo yotzer yirmas tit. ta chaze, kamma inun beni nasha tippeshin dela yadin vela mistakkelin leminda archoy dekudesha berich hu. deha kullehu nayymin, dela mitare shenta bechorehon.

Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu avad leh levar nash, kegavvna dilela. kolla ihu bechachmeta. delet lach shayyfa veshayyfa bevar nash dela kayyma bechachmeta illaa. deha kevan deittakkan kol gufa beshayyfoy kedka yeut, kudesha berich hu ishtattaf (nusach acher ittakkaf) bahadeh, veail beh nishmata kaddisha. begin leolafa leh levar nash lemehach bearchoy deorayyta ulemitar pikkudoy, begin deyittakkan bar nash kedka yeut.

(Sefer acher uvegin da beod) (uvegin sefer acher uveod) deit beh nishmata kaddisha mibbae leh levar nash leasgaa diukena demalka illaa bealma. veraza da, deha hahu nahar denagid venafik la paskan memoy lealmin. veal da mibbae leh levar nash dela yafsik nahara umekora dileh behay alma (gillayon 255 247 lekayyeyma kaddisha dechatim bivsareh, deihu dugema dehahu 255 raza detzaddik deitchabbar 196 kachada leella, begin kach bae bar nash letatta leitchabbera beitteteh bikdushsha begin deittakkaf beh behahu alma). vechol zimna devar nash la yatzlach behay alma (sefer acher veal da mibbae leh levar nash dela yafsik nahara umekora dileh behay alma, vei lo) kudesha berich hu akar leh venata leh bechamma zimnin kemillekaddemin.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, hairoti mitztzafon vayyat. hairoti, da itaruta deziuuga devar nash behay alma, deihu itaruta missitra detzafon. vayat, da hi nishmata kaddisha deatya milleela, vekudesha berich hu meshadder lah milleela. atya behay alma vealat bego bene nasha kidkaamaran.

Mimmizrach shemesh, da atar dehahu nahar denagid venafik demittamman nafkat nishmata veitnehirat. veyavo seganim (kemo chomer) illen inun chelin dealma deatyayn begin (sefer acher bego) hahu itaruta denishmatin. kemo chomer, kegavvna deitar bar nash begufa.

Deha begin da, kudesha berich hu avid zivugin veattil nishmatin bealma, vechavruta ishtakkach leela vetatta umekora decholla hu (sefer acher yehe) baruch. ubbegin kach kudesha berich hu avad leh levar nash begin leishtaddala bearchoy, vela yafsik mekoreh umabbua dileh lealmin.

Vechol man defasik mekoreh, (mittatta umeyabbesh leh kivyachol keillu garim leh laatapesakea leella, keden 0 azlu mayim minni yam venahar yecherav veyavesh, hoil uvar nash ittakam letatta kedugema dilella, man dimkoreh yamish millemebad perin, kegon din dela baa lemetav itteta, o nasiv la deishtaddal velo yachil, ellu ditren happakkin inun da mida, 1 daymaysh millemebad perin, let leh takkana leolam. 2 maavavet lo yachol letikkun, begin dela baa lemesav itteta uleishtaddela bifriyya ureviyya, vehahu deishtaddal venasav itteta velo yachil, da mittakken baperaykayh dekariv leh dehu achoy, vehahu demit belo benin) kad nafik mehay alma hahu bar nash la al befargoda vela natil chulak behahu alma (venishmateh lo itkelilat baatar dechol nishmatin itkelilu, veitgezar diyyukeneh mittamman. hada hu dichtiv, 3 venichreta hannefesh hahi millifne, hoil ucheden hu, bara leh kudesha berich hu parik deyifrok leh mida dimchabbelin, veda achoy dekariv leh shenneemar 4 ki yashvu achim yachdav vegomer. uchetiv ba el eshet achicha veyibbem otah vegomer. begin daneshametayh lo alat kammeh kudesha berich hu, ella hi keyama levar. begin dela zacha leanhara behay alma behahu gufa. man dela zacha behay atar, yehach laatar achara veyizke beh. kegavvna da aa dadelayk unehora lo salik ybetashevan leh visallek nehora beh vaynaheyr. aa hu adam dichtiv 5 ki haadam etz hassade. retzono lomar bar nash kad ihu behay alma vaazal vateayb veachil ushete vaazadevaveg beitteta velo zache levinyan. da hu aa dadelayk unehora lo salik, kelomar nishmateh lo zachat behahu gufa leitnahara ella ihi bechashocha).
372: Ta chaze, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 45:18) lo tohu beraah leshevet yetzarah, dekudesha berich hu begin da avad leh levar nash kedka yeut kedamaran. vekudesha berich hu avad tivu im alma. ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 25:1) vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushemah ketura, raza denishmata atat leittakkana kemilkaddemin.

Ta chaze, hahu gufa ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 53:10) vaAdonai chafetz dakkeo hecholi im tasim asham nafsho yire zera yaarich yamim vechefetz Adonai beyado yitzlach. vaAdonai chafatz dakkeo, hay kera it leistakkala beh, ammay chafetz begin deyitdakke. im tasim asham, im yasim asham mibbae leh, may im tasim. ella lenishmata ahadar milla. i hahi nishmata baya leittakkana kedka yaot, yire zera. begin dehahi nishmata azlat veshatat veihi zemina leoola behahu zera deitassak bah bar nash bifriyya ureviyya, ucheden yaarich yamim. vechefetz Adonai da orayyta bideh atzlach.

Ta chaze, af al gav devar nash ishtaddal beorayyta yemama velelya, umekoreh umabbueh kayyma beh lemaggana, let leh atar leaala lefargoda. veha ittemar devera demaya i hahu mekora umabbua la al beh, lav ihu beer, devera umekora, kechada inun, veraza chada ihu, veokimna.

Ketiv, (Tehillim 127:2) shav lachem mashkime kum meachare shevet ochle lechem haatzavim ken yitten lidido shena. ta chaze, kamma chavivin inun mille deorayyta. dechol milla umilla deorayyta it beh razin illain kaddishin. veha ittemar dechad yahav kudesha berich hu orayyta leyisrael, kol genizin illain kaddishin kullehu yahav lehu (vechullehu) beorayyta, vechullehu ityehivu lehu leyisrael beshata dekabbilu orayyta besinay.

Ta chaze, shav lachem mashkime kum, ilen inun yechidim deishtakkachu, delav inun dechar venukeva kedka yeut, veakdeman betzafra laavidtayhu. kema deat amer, (Kohelet 4:8) yesh echad veen sheni vegomer veen ketz lechol amalo. meachare shevet. meacharin nayycha, kema deat amer, ki vo shavat. begin deitteta legabbe bar nash ihi nayycha legabbeh vadday.

Ochle lechem haatzavim, may lechem haatzavim. dechad bar nash it leh benin, hahu nahama deachil, achil leh bechedva uviruta delibba. vehahu delet leh benin, hahu nahama deachil ihu nahama daatzivu. veillen inun ochle lechem haatzavim vadday.

Ken yitten lidido shena, may yitten lidido, da hu dimkoreh mevarach, dekudesha berich hu yahav leh shena behahu alma kema deat amer, (Mishlei 3:24) veshachavta vearva shenatecha. begin deit leh chulaka bealma deate. begin dehahu bar nash shachiv veyithanne behahu alma deate kedka yeut.

Yesh echad veen sheni vegomer. yesh echad, da hu bar nash deihu yechiday bealma, la yechiday kedka yeut, ella deihu bela ziuuga. veen sheni, delet immeh semech. gam ben, deyokim shemeh beyisrael la shavak. veach (en lo) leayytaa leh letikkuna.
Veen ketz lechol amalo, deihu amel tadir deakdim yemama velelya. gam eno lo tisba osher, velet leh libba leashgacha ulememar lemi ani amel umechasser et nafshi
373: Mittova. vei tema divgin deyechul veyishte yattir veyaaved mishtaya bechol yoma tadir, lav hachi. deha nafsha la ithanni minneh, ella vadday ihu mechasser lenafsheh mittivu dinhora dealma deate. begin deda hi nafsha chasra, dela ishtallimat kedka yeut. ta chaze, kamma chas kudesha berich hu al ovadoy, begin deka bae deyittakkan, vela yitavid mehahu alma deate kidkaamaran.

Ribbi chiyyay baa, hay deihu zakkaa shelema veishtedal beorayyta yome velele vechol ovadoy lishma dekudesha berich hu, vela zacha livnin behay alma kegon deishtaddal behu vela zacha, o dehavu leh umitu. ma inun lealma deate. amar leh ribbi yose, ovadoy vehahi orayyta, ka maginan aleh lehahu alma.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, alayyhu veal inun zakkae keshot, (kegon rabbi yochanan dahavo leh benin umitu, uchegon rabbi chizkiyya deihu ikkar) alayyhu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) ko amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay uvacharu baasher chafatzti umachazikim bivriti. ma ketiv batreh, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo asher lo yikkaret. begin deillen it lon chulaka lealma deate. amar leh ribbi yose, yaot hu veshappir.

Ta chaze, zakkaa shelim dehavu kol illen beh, veishtelim kedka yeut, umit bela benin, veha ka yarit ducheteh behahu alma, itteteh baya livume o la. i tema delibbae livume, ha berekanya ihu, deha atreh ka yarit behahu alma.

Ella vadday baya livume, begin dela yadinan i hava shelim beovadoy i lav. vehi i ityaybmat la hava berekanya. begin deatar it leh lekudesha berich hu deha (30) bar nash (4) hava bealma umit bela benin ufuraka la have leh bealma, kevan demit hay zakkaa shelim veittete ityaybmat, veihu atreh yarit. ata hahu bar nash veishtallim hacha, uven kach uven kach kudesha berich hu, atar zammin leh (lealma) (bealma) ad deyemut hay zakkaa shelim, veyishtelim ihu bealma. hada hu dichtiv (Bamidbar 35:28) ki veir miklato yeshev ad mot hakkohen haggadol vegomer.

Veda hu detaninan, benin zeminin inun letzaddikaya bemitathon, bechayyehon la zachu uvemitathon zachu. uvegin kach kol ovadoy dekudesha berich hu kullehu keshot uzechu, (sefer acher vechayis) vechayyim al kolla.

(Kohelet 4:9) tovim hashshenayim min haechad asher yesh lahem sachar tov baamalam, illen inun demitassekin behay alma leolada benin. deinun benin deshavku, beginehon it lon agar tav behahu alma, uveginehu yartin avahan dilhon chulaka behahu alma veukemuha.
Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu nata ilanin behay alma i atzlachu yaot, la atzlachu aakar lon veshatal lon afillu kamma zimnin. ubbegin kach kol archoy dekudesha berich hu kullehu letav uleatkana alma:

Bo el eshet achicha veyabbem otah, deha yehuda vechullehu shivtin havu yade da. veikkera demilleta, vehakem zera. begin dehahu zera itzterich leittakkana milla ulemiglam golama letikkuna dela yitperash giza mishsharsheh kedka yeut, hada hu dichtiv (Iyov la) veadam al afar yashuv.

Vechad mittakkan levatar kedka yaot, illen mishtabbechin behahu alma begin dekudesha berich hu itrae behu. uvegin kach ketiv, (Kohelet 4:2) veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu, dayyka. min hachayyim asher hemma chayyim adenna. may adenna, kema deat amer (Bereshit 18:12) achare veloti hayta li edna. uchetiv (Iyov 33:25) yashuv lime alumav.

Vetov mishshenihem et asher aden lo haya (dela shav lime alumav) asher lo raa et hammaase hara asher naasa tachat hashshemesh. vetov mishshenihem et asher aden lo haya, dela shav lime alumav vela itzterich leittakkana, vela savil chovin kadmae, begin dekudesha berich hu
374: Yahav leh atar metakna behahu alma kedka yaot.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Kohelet 8:10) uvechen raiti reshaim kevurim vegomer, kema deittemar. begin dekudesha berich hu avid tivu vela vaa leshetzaa alma ella kema deittemar, vechol archoy kullehu keshot uzechu leotava lehu behay alma uvealma deate. zakkaa chulekehon detzaddikayay deinun azle beorach keshot, alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 37:29) tzaddikim yirshu aretz:

Vayyera beene Adonai asher asa vayyamet gam oto. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Kohelet 11:6) babboker zera et zaracha velaerev al tannach yadcha vegomer. ta chaze, kamma itchaze leh levar nash leizdahara mechovoy, uleizdahara beovadoy kamme kudesha berich hu. begin dechamma shelichan vechamma memannan inun bealma, deinun azlin veshayytan, vechaman ovadehon divne nasha, vesahadin aloy (15 alayyhu) vecholla besifra chetivin.

Veta chaze, bechol inun chovin deistaav behu var nash behay alma, da ihu chova deistaav beh var nash yattir behay alma uvealma deate. man deoshid zareh berekanya, veappik zara lemaggana bida o beragla veistaav beh. kema deat amer, (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra.

Begin da la al lefargoda, vela chame sevar appe attik yomin, kema detaninan ketiv hacha lo yegurecha ra, uchetiv vayhi er bechor yehuda ra beene Adonai. uvegin kach ketiv, (Yeshayahu 1:15-16) yedechem damim maleu. zakkaa chulakeh devar nash dedachil lemareh vihe netir meorach bisha, veyadke garmeh leishtaddala bidchilu demareh.

Ta chaze, babboker zera et zarecha, hay kera ukemuha. babboker, da hu bezimna devar nash itkayyem becheleh vihe beulemo, keden ishtaddal leolada benin beitteta dechazya leh, dichtiv babboker zera et zarecha.

Deha keden zimna ihu kema deat amer, (Tehillim 127:4) kechitztzim beyad gibbor ken beni hanneurim. begin deyachil lemelaf lehu archoy dekudesha berich hu, vihe leh agra tava lealma deate. dichtiv ashre haggever asher mille et ashpato mehem lo yevoshu ki yedabberu et oyvim bashshaar. lo yevoshu behahu alma, bezimna demarehon dedina yetun lekatrega aloy. delet lach agra tava behahu alma, kehahu deolif leh livreh dechilu demareh bearchoy deorayyta.

Ta chaze ma amar beavraham, dichtiv, (Bereshit 18:19) ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve et banav veet beto acharav veshamru derech Adonai laasot tzedaka umishpat. veal da hahu zechu kayyma leh behahu alma legabbe kol marehon dedina.

Uvegin kach babboker zera et zarecha, velaerev al tannach yadecha, afillu beyome dezikna, deihu zimna desiv var nash (lo yema kevar ashetadelayt vedi li o kevar ashetadelayt velo yachilna vehasheta daana siv let ana bae veim kol da) ma ketiv al tannach yadecha la yishbok milleolada behay alma. may tama, begin dela teda eze yichshar hazze o ze lifne haelohim. begin dikumun begineh behahu alma.

Veal da ketiv (Tehillim 127:3) hinne nachalat Adonai banim, da tzerora denishmata sitra dealma deate, ulehay nachala man zache leh levar nash leaala behahu nachalat Adonai, banim. inun benin zachan leh lenachalat Adonai, veal da zakkaa hahu bar nash dezache lon deyolif lon archoy deorayyta kema deittemar:

Vattasar bigde almenutah mealeha vegomer, ta chaze, tamar bat kohen havat, vechi salka datach deihi azla begin leaznaa im chamuha, deha ihi tzeniuta ishtakkechat bah tadir. ella ihi tzaddeket havat uvechachma avdat hay, deha ihi la afkarat garmah legabbeh, ella begin didia yadat vechachmeta istakkalat. veal da ihi atat legabbeh lemebad (immeh) tivu ukeshot, veal da atat (lahedayh) veishtaddelat beiska da.
Ta chaze, begin deihi yadat yedia veishtaddelat beiska da. kudesha berich hu avad siyyua tamman behahu ovada veitabberat miyyad. vecholla hava
375: Minneh. vei tema ammay la ayyte kudesha berich hu inun benin meitteta ochara, ammay min da. ella vadday ihi itztericha leovada da vela itteta ochora.

Teren neshin havu deminnayyhu itbene zara dihuda, veatu minnayyhu david malka ushelomo malka umalka meshicha. veillen teren neshin da kegavvna deda, tamar verut demitu baalayyhu bekadmita, veinun ishtaddelu leovada da.

Tamar ishtaddelat legabbe chamuha deihu kariv yattir livnoy demitu. may tama ihi ishtaddelat legabbeh, dichtiv ki raata ki gadal shela vehi lo nittena lo leishsha. uvegin da ishtaddelat beovada da legabbe chamuha.

Rut mit baalah ulevatar ishtaddelat beovada da legabbeh devoaz dichtiv, (Rut 3:7) vattegal margelotav vattishkav. veishtaddelat bahadeh ulevatar olidat leh leoved. vei tema ammay la nafik oved meitteta ochora, ella vadday hi itzterichat vela itteta ochora. umitteren illen itbeni veishtachlil zara dihuda, vetarvavyeyhu bechashrut avdu lemebad tivu im inun metayay leittakkena alma levatar.

Veda hu kema deittemar (Kohelet 4:2) veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu, deha kad havu chayyin bekadmita la hava behu shevacha (15 ulevatar hava behu shevacha), vetarvavyyhu ishtaddelu lemebad tivu ukeshot im innun metayay, vekudesha berich hu siyyea behahu ovada vecholla hava kedka yaot. zakkaa ihu man deishtaddal beorayyta yemama velelya. kema deat amer, (Yehoshua 1:8) vehagita vo yomam valayla lemaan tishmor laasot kechol hakkatuv bo ki az tatzliach et derachecha vegomer:

Veyosef hurad mitzrayma vayyiknehu potifar vegomer. (45 ketiv leel vayyakker yehuda vayyomer, ihu amar legabbe avoy hakkar na vegomer, veal da vayyakker yehuda. uchetiv vehinne teomim bevitnah. taavameyn havo mikkadmat dena achin havo. rabbi chizkiyya amar, lo ishtema hachi. ella benin acharanin ityelidu. amar rabbi abba, begin kach ishtaddelat leashkecha ovda deitavid. ta chaze ma ketiv, vayhi chemeshiv yado vehinne yatza achiv vattomer ma paratzta alecha peretz. ramaz hacha peritzuta kadmaa defaritz hahu demit aleh mashma dichtiv paratzta alecha peritzuta begin daatzateraykat leatrecha lamerach uvegin kach peritzuta taaved bishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da Vayikra et shemo peretz. ulevatar dechol ovada dihuda ittemar dihuda zavin leh leyosef. veihu garim leh lechol hay. dei yehuda hava amar nehdar leh leavuna havo avdin leh achoy has veal da nachtu leh achoy mashelatenavetaa daalayhu. levatar deitgele maachavey vaata aleh kol da ahdar veamar veyosef hored mitzrayma) may hurad. deistakkam kudesha berich hu behahu ovada lekayyma gezera dileh digzar ben habbetarim dichtiv, (Bereshit 15:13) yadoa teda ki ger yihye zaracha vegomer. vayyiknehu potifar listar chataa kana leh.

Patach veamar, (Iyov 9:7) haomer lacheres velo yizrach uvead kochavim yachtom. ta chaze, shiva kochvaya avad kudesha berich hu birkia, vechol rekia urekia it beh kamma shammashin memannin leshammasha leh lekudesha berich hu.
Begin delet lach shammasha o memanna delet leh pulechana veshimmusha lemareh, vekayyme kol chad vechad al hahu shimmusha deitpakda beh, vechol chad yada avidteh leshammasha.

Minnehon meshammeshe bishlichuta demarehon veitpakkedan bealma al kol ovadehon divne nasha, uminnehon deka meshabbechin leh veinun (ha) itpakkedan al shirata. veaf al gav deinun itpakkedan behay, let lach kol chela bishmayay vechochavin umazzale dechullehu la meshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu.
Deha beshata deal lelya keden itparshan telat sitrin mashshiryayn litlat sitre alma, uvechol sitra vesitra elef alfin veribbo rivvan vechullehu memannan al
376: Telat mashshiryayn inun, vechad chevata kaddisha memanna alayyhu vekayyma alayyhu, vechullehu ka meshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu ad deate tzafra, kad ate tzafra, kol inun devistar darom vechol kochvaya denahare, kullehu meshabbechan veamre shirata lekudesha berich hu kema deat amer, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kol bene elohim. beran yachad kochve voker, illen kochvaya devistar darom kema deat amer, (Bereshit 19:27) vayyashkem avraham babboker. vayyariu kol bene elohim, illen inun devistar semala deitkelilu bimina.

Ucheden tzafra nahir, veyisrael natle shirata umeshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu bimama, telat zimnin bimama, lokovel telat zimnin delelya. vekayymin illen lokovel illen, ad deyistallak yekara dekudesha berich hu bimama uvelelya kedka yeut, vekudesha berich hu istallak behu beshit illen.

Hahu chevata kaddisha dekayyma alayyhu leela kayyma al yisrael letatta begin leatkana kolla kedka yeut. ma ketiv bah (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. vattitten teref levetah illen inun mashshiryayn dilela, vechok lenaaroteha illen mashshiryayn deyisrael letatta, uvegin kach yekara dekudesha berich hu istallak mikkol sitrin meela umittatta. veal da kolla hava (sefer acher hu) birshuteh kayyma, vecholla ihu biruteh.

(Iyov 9:7) haomer lacheres velo yizrach. ribbi shimon amar, da yosef. uvead kochavim yachtom, illen inun achoy dichtiv behu vaachad asar kochavim mishtachavim li. davar acher haomer lacheres, da yaakov, beshata deamru lo hakker na. velo yizrach, beshata deistalkat shechinta minneh. uvead kochavim yachtom, begin benoy itchattam veastim nehora dileh, shimsha itchashach vechochvaya la nehiru begin deyosef itparash meavoy. veta chaze, mehahu yoma dehahu ovada deyosef, itperash yaakov mishshimmusha dearsa veishtaar avela ad hahu yoma deitbassar besora deyosef:

Vayhi Adonai et yosef vayhi ish matzliach vayhi bevet adonav vegomer. ribbi yose patach, (Tehillim 37:28) ki Adonai ohev mishpat velo yaazov et chasidav leolam nishmaru. hay kera ukemuha beavraham, et chasidav, chasido ketiv, veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, bechol atar detzaddikaya azle, kudesha berich hu natir lon vela shavik lon. david amar, (Tehillim 23:4) gam ki elech bege tzalmavet lo ira ra ki atta immadi shivtecha umishantecha vegomer. bechol atar detzaddikaya azle, shechinta azla immehon vela shavik lon.

Yosef azal bege tzalmavet venachatu leh lemitzrayim, shechinta havat immeh. hada hu dichtiv, vayhi Adonai et yosef. uvegin dehavat immeh shechinta bechol ma dehava avid hava matzlach bideh. deafillu may dehava bideh vehava tava leh mareh begavvna ochora, hava mithappech bideh lehahu gavvna diruta demareh hava rae beh. kema deat amer, vayyar adonav ki Adonai itto vechol asher hu ose Adonai matzliach beyado, matzliach beyado vadday, ki Adonai itto.

Ta chaze, vayyeda adonav ki Adonai itto la ketiv, ella vayyar adonav, deha beenoy hava chame ovada denissin bechol yoma dekudesha berich hu avid bideh, veal da vayvarech Adonai et bet hammitzri biglal yosef. kudesha berich hu natir lon letzaddikaya uveginehon natar lon lerashshiaya, deha rashshiaya mitbarchin beginehon detzaddikaya. kegavvna da ketiv, (Shmuel 2 6:12) vayvarech Adonai et bet oved edom haggitte baavur aron haelohim.

Tzaddikaya, ochoranin mitbarchin beginayyhu, veinun la yachlu leittezna (sefer acher leishtezava) bizchutayyhu, veha ukemuha. yosef itbarech mareh begineh, veihu la yachil leishtezava bizchuteh minneh ulenafka lecheru.

Ulevatar ail leh bevet hassohar kema deat amer (Tehillim 105:18-19) innu vakkevel raglo barzel baa nafsho, ad dilvatar kudesha berich hu appik leh lecheru veshalteh al kol ara demitzrayim. uvegin kach ketiv velo yaazov et chasidav leolam
377: Nishmaru, chasido ketiv veittemar. vekudesha berich hu agin alayyhu detzaddikaya, bealma den uvealma deate. dichtiv, (Tehillim Adonai:12) veyismechu chol chose vach leolam yeranninu vetasech alemu veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha:

Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle vattissa eshet adonav et eneha el yosef. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 103:20) barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro. ta chaze, kamma itzterich leh levar nash leistammera mechovoy, ulemehach beorach mittakkena. begin dela yiste leh hahu yetzer hara, deihu mekatrega leh kol yoma veyoma, kema deittemar.

Uvegin deihu mekatrega leh tadir, bae bar nash leittakkefa aleh, uleistalleka aleh beatar takkifu. devae lemeheve gavar aleh, uleishtattefa beatar digvura. begin dechad var nash itkaf aleh, keden ihu bistar gevura, veitdabbak beh leittakkefa. uvegin dehahu yetzer hara takkif, bae var nash dihe takkif mineh.

Veillen bene nasha deittakkefu aleh, ikrun gibbore choach, leishtakkecha zina im zineh. veillen inun malachav dekudesha berich hu, deatyayn missitra digvura kashya, leittakkefa aleh, gibbore koach ose devaro. barchu Adonai malachav, keyosef, deikre tzaddik vegibbor venatar berit kaddisha deitreshim begavveh.

Ribbi elazar amar, vayhi achar haddevarim haelle, may hi, ha ukemuha atar da deyetzer hara mekatreg, deihu darga achar haddevarim. begin deyosef yahav leh ducheta lekatraga, dehava yosef mesalsel besaareh veatkin garmeh vekashshit leh, keden ityehiv ducheta layetzer hara lekatrega. deamar, uma avoy deihu mitabbel aleh, veyosef mekashshit garmeh, umesalsel besaareh, keden itgare beh dubba vekatrig leh:

Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle. ta chaze, bezimna dekudesha berich hu ashgach beh bealma, lemedan yateh, veashkach chayyayvin bealma, ma ketiv, (Devarim 11:17) veatzar et hashshamayim velo yihye matar vehaadama lo titten et yevulah, ucheden vaavadtem mehera. deha begin chovin divne nasha, shemaya veara itatzaru, vela nahage nimmusehon kedka yeut.

Veta chaze, inun dela natru lehay keyayma dekudesha, garme perishu ben yisrael laavuhon devishmaya, begin dichtiv vesartem vaavadtem elohim acherim vehishtachavitem lahem, uchetiv veatzar et hashshamayim velo yihye matar. dehay ihu keman desagid lelaha ochora, dimshakker behay at keyayma kaddisha.

Vechad keyayma kaddisha itnetir bealma kedka yaot, keden kudesha berich hu yahiv birchan leela leatraka bealma. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 68:10) geshem nedavot tanif elohim nachalatcha venila atta chonanta. geshem nedavot, da geshem diruta. kad itrae kudesha berich hu bichneset yisrael, uvae laaraka lah birchan, keden nachalatcha venila atta chonanta.

Nachalatcha, inun yisrael, deinun achsanteh dekudesha berich hu. kema deat amer, (Devarim 32:9) yaakov chevel nachalato. venila, da keneset yisrael, deihi nila beara ochora, deihi tzachya lemishte, ucheden ihi nila. vechad hahu geshem diruta ityehiv, keden atta konanta.

Veal da, shemaya veara, vechol chelehon, kullehu kayyma al kiyyuma da. dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. ubbegin kach bae leizdahara beda, veha ukemuha. uvegin kach ketiv, vayhi yosef yefe toar vife mare, uvatreh ketiv vattissa eshet adonav et eneha el yosef.

Vayhi kedabberah elav yom yom. ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Mishlei 6:24) lishmarcha meeshet ra vegomer, zakkain inun tzaddikayya, deyade archoy dekudesha berich hu, lemezal behu. begin deinun mishtaddele beorayyta yemama velelya. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta yome velele, achsin teren almin, alma illaa, vealma
378: Tattaa. achsin hay alma, af al gav dela itassak bah bar nash lishmah, veachsin hahu alma illaa, kad itassak bah bar nash lishmah.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Mishlei 3:16) orech yamim biminah bismolah osher vechavod. orech yamim biminah, man deazil limina deorayyta, archa dechayyin ihu lealma deate. dezache tamman likara deorayyta, deihu yekara vechitra, leitattera al kolla. dechitra deorayyta behahu alma ihu. bismolah osher vechavod, behay alma, deaf al gav dela itassak bah lishmah, zache behay alma beutera vikara.

Deha ribbi chiyyay kad ata mehatam leara deyisrael, kara beorayyta, ad dehavu anpoy nehirin keshimsha. vechad havu kayymin kammeh kol inun delaan beorayyta. hava amar, da ishtaddal beorayyta lishmah, veda la ishtaddal lishmah, vehava tzalle al hahu deitassak lishmah, delehve hachi tadir, veyizke lealma deate. vetzalle al hahu dela itassak bah lishmah, deyete leitasseka bah lishmah, veyizke lechayye alma.

Yoma chad, chama chad talmid dehava lae beorayyta, veanpoy morikan. amar, vadday mehareher becheta ihu dena. achid leh lekammeh, veamshich aleh bemillin deorayyta, ad deityayshav rucheh begavveh. min hahu yoma ulehala, shavve al rucheh, dela yirdof batar inun hirhurin bishin, veyishtaddal beorayyta lishmah.

Amar ribbi yose, kad chame var nash dehirhurin bishin atyayn legabbeh, yitassak beorayyta, ucheden yitavrun minneh. amar ribbi elazar, kad hahu sitra bisha ate lemifte leh levar nash, yehe mashich leh legabbe orayyta, veyitperash minneh.

Ta chaze, deha taninan, dechad hay sitra visha kayyma kammeh dekudesha berich hu leastaa al alma begin ovadin bishin. kudesha berich hu chas al alma, veyahiv eta livne nasha, leishtezava minneh. vela yachil leshaltaa alehon vela al ovadehon, umay ihu eta, leishtaddela beorayyta, veishtezavu minneh. menalan, dichtiv, (Mishlei 6:23) ki ner mitzva vetora or vederech chayyim tochchot musar. ma ketiv batreh lishmarcha meeshet ra mechelkat lashon nachriyya.

Veda hu sitra mesaava, sitra ochora. deihi kayyma tadir kammeh kudesha berich hu, leastaa al chovehon divne nasha. vekayyma tadir leastaa letatta livni nasha. kayyma tadir leela, begin leadkara chovehon divni nasha, uleastaa lon al ovadehon. uvegin deityehivu birshuteh, kema deavad leh leiyyov.

Vechen kayyma alayyhu leastaa uleadkara chovehon bechol ma deavadu, beinun zimnin dekudesha berich hu kayyma alayyhu bedina. keden kaim leastaa lon uleadkara chovehon. vekudesha berich hu chas alayyhu deyisrael, veyahav lon eta leishtezava minneh. uvemma, bashshofar beyoma derosh hashshana, uveyoma dechippure besair hammishtalleach deyahavin leh, begin leitperasha minnayyhu, uleishtaddela behahu chulakeh, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Mishlei Adonai:Adonai) ragleha yordot mavet sheol tzeadeha yitmochu. uveraza dimhemnuta ma ketiv, (Mishlei 3:17) deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom. veillen inun archin ushevilin deorayyta, vecholla chad. hay shalom vehay mavt, vecholla hippuchan da min da.

Zakkaa chulekehon deyisrael, deinun mitdabbekin beh bekudesha berich hu kedka chaze, veyahiv lon eta leishtezava mikkol sitrin ochoranin dealma. begin deinun amma kaddisha leachsanteh vechulakeh, veal da yahiv lon eta becholla. zakkain inun bealma den, uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, kad hay sitra bisha nachat veshat bealma, vechame ovadin divne nasha, deinun kullehu satin archayyhu bealma. salik leela veastin lon, veilmale dekudesha berich hu chayis al ovade yedoy, la yishtaarun bealma.
Ma ketiv vayhi kedabberah el yosef yom yom. kedabberah,
379: Desalka vesate bechol yoma veyoma, veamar kamme kudesha berich hu, kamma bishin kamma diltorin, begin leshetzaa beni alma.

Ma ketiv, velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihyot immah. velo shama eleha, begin deihu chayis al alma. lishkav etzlah, mahu lishkav etzlah. begin lenasva shaltanu, leshalletaa al alma, veshaltanu la shalta, ad deityehiv leh reshu.

Davar acher lishkav etzlah, kema deat amer, (Vayikra 15:33) uleish asher yishkav im temea. lihyot immah lemehav lah revu uvirchan vesiyyayta. deillemale siyyua hava lah milleela, la ishtaar bealma afillu chad. aval begin dekudesha berich hu chayis al alma, ishtaar alma bekiyyumeh.

Ribbi abba amar, kolla ihu archa chada, aval yetzer hara hu deka azil umefatte lon livne nasha, begin leastaa archayyhu uleitdabbeka behu, bechol yoma veyoma, uvechol idan veidan. sate leh levar nash mearcha dikshot, begin ledachyay leh mearcha dechayye, leamshacha leh laggehinnom.

Zakkaa ihu man deavid venatir (nusach acher zakkaa may avid, natir) archoy usheviloy, begin dela yitdabbak beh. hayeynu dichtiv vayhi kedabberah el yosef yom yom velo shama eleha, kemma (nusach acher bema) deihi amrat leh bechol yoma. deha ruach mesaava, yetzer hara, ihu mefatte leh levar nash, bechol yoma, lishkav etzlah, go gehinnom, uleitdana tamman, lihyot immah.

Ta chaze, kad var nash itdabbak behahu sitra, itmeshach avatrah, veistaav immah behay alma, veistaav immah bealma ochora. ta chaze, hay sitra mesaava, menuvala ihu, lichlucha ihu. kedichtiv, (Yeshayahu 30:22) tze tomar lo, tzoa mammash. uveh itdan man deaste archoy min orayyta, uveh itdanu inun chayyayvin dealma, delet lon mehemnuta bekudesha berich hu.

Ma ketiv, vayhi kehayyom hazze vayyavo habbayta laasot melachto veen ish meanshe habbayit sham babbayit. vayhi kehayyom hazze, yoma deyetzer hara shalta bealma, venachata leastaa livne nasha. ematay, yoma deate bar nash leatava bityuveta al chovoy, o leishtaddela beorayyta, ulemebad pikkude deorayyta. ucheden behahu zimna nachata, begin leastaa livne alma.

Vayyavo habbayta laasot melachto, begin leishtaddela beorayyta ulemebad pikkude deorayyta, deihu melachto devar nash behay alme. vechevan deavidta devar nash behay alma, hu avidta dekudesha berich hu. bae le levar nash, lemeheve takkifa kearya bechol sitroy, begin dela yishlot aloy sitra ochora, vela yachil lemifte leh. ma ketiv veen ish, let gevar deyekum lekovleh deyetzer hara, veyiggach beh kerava kedka yaot.

May orcheh deyetzer hara, kevan dechame delet bar nash kaim lekovleh uleaggacha beh kerava, miyyad: vattitpesehu bevigdo lemor shichva immi. vattitpesehu bevigdo, begin dechad shallit yetzer hara aleh devar nash, atkin leh, vekashshit leh levushoy, mesalsel besaareh. hada hu dichtiv vattitpesehu bevigdo lemor shichva immi, itdabbak immi.

Man deihu zakkaa, ittakkaf lekovleh, veaggach beh kerava. ma ketiv, vayyaazov bigdo beyadah vayyanas vayyetze hachutza, yishbok leh, veyittakkaf lekovleh. (sefer acher veaggach beh kerava) veyearok minneh, begin leishtezava minneh, vela yishlot aloy.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, zeminin inun tzaddikaya lemechome leyetzer hara, kechad tura ravreva, veyitmehun veyemrun. ech yachilna leakkefya leh letura ravreva haden illaa. uzeminin rashshiaya lemecheme leh leyetzer hara, dakkik kechuta desaara, veyitmehun veyemrun. hech la yachilna leakkefya lechuta desaara keda dakkik. illen yivkun veillen yivkun. vekudesha berich hu yevaer leh mealma, veyikkos leh leenayyhu, vela yishlot od bealma, veyechomun tzaddikaya veyechedun. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha.
380: Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle chatu mashke melech mitzrayim vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach, (Amos 3:4) hayishag arye bayyaar veteref en lo hayitten kefir kolo mimmeonato bilti im lachad. hayishag arye bayyaar. ta chaze, kamma it lon livne nasha leashgacha befulechana dekudesha berich hu. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, uvefulechana dekudesha berich hu, dachalteh veemateh hu al kolla. deha kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, avad kol biryayn dealma, kol chad vechad bediukeneh kedka chaze leh. ulevatar bara leh levar nash bediukena illaa, veshalteh al kullehu, bediukena da.

Dechol zimna devar nash kaim bealma, kol inun biryayn dealma zakfin resha, umistakkelan bediukena illaa devar nash. keden kullehu dachalin vezain mikkammeh, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 9:2) umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kol chayyat haaretz veal kol of hashshamayim vegomer, vehanne mile, kad mistakkelan vechaman beh, hay diukena, venishmata beh.

Amar ribbi elazar, af al gav denishmata lav beh, tzaddikaya la mishtanyayn mikkema dehava deyukenhon bekadmita. vechad bar nash la azil bearchoy deorayyta, hay diukena kaddisha itchallaf leh. ucheden chevat bera veofa dishmaya yachlin leshalletaa aleh, begin deitchallaf leh hay diukena kaddisha, itchallaf leh hay diukena devar nash.

Veta chaze, kudesha berich hu achlaf ovadin dilela vetatta, begin leahadara millin leatrayyhu, uleishtakkecha reuteh bechol ovade dealma. daniyyel la ishtanne diukeneh kad appilu leh beguva dearyevata, uvegin kach ishteziv. amar ribbi chizkiyya, i hachi, ha ketiv, (Daniel 6:23) elahi shelach malacheh usagar pum aryavata vela chabbeluni. mashma divgin malacha deasgar lefumayyhu, la itchabbal.

Amar leh, begin da la itchabbal, deha hahu diukeneh devar nash zakkaa, ihu malacha mammash, disgir puma, vekashir lon, lenatra leh, dela yechabbelun leh. ubbegin kach elahi shelach malacheh, hahu dechol diukenin dealma mitchakkekan beh, veihu atkif diukeni bi, vela yachilu leshaltaa bi, vesagar pumayyhu, veal da shalach malacheh vadday.

Vehay malacha, hahu dechol diukenin mitchakkekan beh. dichtiv, (Tehillim 110:6) yadin baggoyim male geviyyot, ihu dela ishtanne kammeh kol diukenin dealma. veal da mibbae leh levar nash, leistammera archoy usheviloy, begin dela yechota kammeh demareh, veyitkayyaym bediukena deadam.

Ta chaze, yechezkel natar pumeh mimmaachale deissure, dichtiv, (ychezakealed) vela ba befi besar piggul, zacha veikre ben adam. daniyyel ma ketiv beh, (Daniel 1:8) vayyasem daniyyel al libbo asher la yitgaal befat bag hammelech uveyen mishtav, zacha hu, veitkeyyaym bidiukeneh deadam. begin dechol millin dealma, kullehu dachalin mikkamme diukena deadam, deihu shallita al kullehu, veihu malka al kolla.

Amar ribbi yose, begin da itzterich leh levar nash, leistammera mechovoy, vela yiste limina velismala. veim kol da, bae leh levar nash lemivdak bechovoy bechol yoma veyoma. deha kad var nash kaim mearseh, teren sahadin kayymin kammeh, veazle bahadeh kol yoma.

Bae bar nash lemekam, inun sahade amrin leh beshata deaftach enoy, (Mishlei 4:25) enecha lenochach yabbitu veafappecha yayshiru negdecha. kam veatkin ragloy lemehach, inun sahadin amrin leh, (sham) palles magal raglecha vegomer. veal da kad azil var nash, bechol yoma, bae leh leistammera mechovoy.

Bechol yoma veyoma, kad ate lelya, bae leistakkela ulemivdak, bechol ma deavad kol hahu yoma. begin deyetuv minnayyhu, veyistakkel behu tadir, begin deyetuv kamme mareh. kema deat amer (Tehillim 51:5) vechattati negdi tamid, begin deyetuv minnayyhu.
Veta chaze, bezimna dehavu yisrael beara kaddisha, la ishtakkach bidayyhu chova, kema deukemuha. begin deinun karbanin, dehavu makrivin bechol yoma,
381: Havu mechappere alayyhu. hasheta deitgalon yisrael meara, velet man dimchapper alayyhu, orayyta hi mechappera alayyhu, veovadin dechashran, begin dishchinta immehon begaluta. uman deihu la mistakkal bearchoy dekudesha berich hu, garim lishchinta leitkafya bego afra, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 26:5) yashpilenna yashpilah ad aretz vegomer.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, vechen man deishtaddal beorayyta uveovadin dechashran, garim lah lekneset yisrael, laarama resha bego galuta. zakkaa chulakehon deinun demishtaddele beorayyta yemama velele.

Ta chaze, gilgel kudesha berich hu gilgulin bealma, begin laarama resha detzaddikayay, deha begin deyarim yosef resheh bealma, al deishtakkach zakkaa kammeh, argiz ribbona al avdoy. kema deat amer chatu mashke melech mitzrayim vehaofe laadonehem lemelech mitzrayim. vecholla begin laarama resha deyosef zakkaa. veta chaze, al yeda dechelma, itkafyay meim achoy, veal yeda dechelma itrabbe al achoy, veitrabbe al kol alma:

Vayyachalmu chalom shenehem ish chalomo belayla echad ish kefitron vegomer, ta chaze, deha ittemar dechol chelmin azlin batar puma, yosef kad pashar lehu chelma, ammay pashar lehay pishra tava, ulehay pishra bisha. ella, inun chelmin aleh deyosef hava, uvegin deyada milla al ikkara vesharsha dilah, begin kach pashar chelma lehu kema deitzterich. lechol chad vechad pashar lehon pishra, leahadara milla al atreh.

Ma ketiv vayyomer alehem yosef halo lelohim pitronim sapperu na li. may tama, begin dehachi mibbae leh lemifshar chelma, lefakda pishra lekudesha berich hu, begin detamman ihu kiyyuma decholla, uveh kayyma pishra.

Ta chaze, ha ittemar dedarga dechelma letatta ihu, veihu darga shetitaa. begin deha meatar dinvua sharya ad hay darga dechelma, shitta dargin inun. vesalka pishra middarga dechelma, ledarga ochora. chelma ihu darga diltatta, ufishra kayyma alayyhu. ufishra kayyma bedibbur, veal da bedibbur kayyma milla. dichtiv halo lelohim pitronim, halo lelohim vadday.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vaysapper sar hammashkim et chalomo leyosef vegomer. ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Melachim 2 2:9) vayhi beavram veeliyyahu amar el elisha sheal ma eese lach beterem ellakach meimmach vayyomer elisha vihi na pi shenayim beruchacha elay. hacha it leistakkala, vehay kera tevavha ihu. veeliyyahu amar el elisha sheal ma eese lach, vechi birshuteh kayyma, veha birshuteh dekudesha berich hu ihu. vetu, deelisha hachi name ihu hava yada, may tama amar, vihi na pi shenayim beruchacha elay.

Ella vadday, man deachid bishmaya veara vechol almin, hech la yehe birshuteh da. vadday eliyyahu, ushear tzaddikim, kudesha berich hu avid reutehon detzaddikayyay tadir. dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:19) retzon yereav yaase, vechol shekken dehahu rucha kaddisha, di aleh, yarit leh letzaddika deelisha, dehava shammasha dileh. veha kudesha berich hu amar leh (Melachim 1 19:16) veet elisha ben shafat meavel mechola timshach lenavi tachtecha, veal da hava leh leelisha leyarta leh.

Pi shenayim beruchacha, may pi shenayim beruchacha elay, vechi salka datach, deal chad teren shail, uma dela hava birshuteh, hech shaal mineh. ella, ihu la shail ruach al chad teren, ela (ihu) hachi shaal minneh, behahu rucha dehava leh, deyaavid (davar acher 33 chad) teren nimmusin bealma, behahu rucha.

Ma ketiv vayyomer hiksheta lishol im tire oti lukkach meittach yehi lecha chen veim ayin lo yihye. may tama im tire oti. ella amar leh, im techul lemekam al ikkara derucha dishavakna lach, beshata deitnasivna minach, yehe lecha keden. deha kol hahu ikkara derucha beshata deyistakkel beh, kad chame leh leeliyyahu, yeheve devekuta beh, kedka yeut.
382: Ta chaze, hay man deistakkal bemma deolif merabbeh, vechame leh behahu chachmeta, yachil leittosfa behahu rucha yattir. ta chaze, deha yosef bechol ma deihu avid, have chame berucha dechachmeta lehahu diukena deavoy, hava mistakkal. uvegin kach hava mistayya leh milleta, veittosfa leh rucha ochora, binhiru illaa yattir.

Beshata deamar leh hahu rasha, vehinne gefen lefanay, izdaza yosef. dela hava yada al ma tete milla, kevan deamar uvaggefen shelosha sarigim, miyyad itar rucheh, veittosaf binhiru, veistakkal bediukena deavoy, keden itnehir rucheh, veyada milla.

Ma ketiv, uvaggefen shelosha sarigim. amar yosef, ha vadday besora dechedva bishlimu ihu, may tama, begin dehay gefen al keneset yisrael itchaze leh, veitbassar yosef behay. uvaggefen shelosha sarigim, illen inun telata dargin ilain, denafke mehay gefen, kahane levae veyisreele.

Vehi cheforachat alta nitztzah, deha veginehon salka keneset yisrael, veitbarchat meim malka illaa. hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim, illen inun tzaddikaya dealma, deinun kaanavim mevushalim kedka chaze. davar acher hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim, da hu yayin deitnetir beinvayyhu mishsheshet yeme vereshit.
Ad hacha itbassar yosef bechelmeh, mikkan ulehala chelma ihu dileh, begin deit chelmin leh, uleacharanin. vaekach et haanavim, deihu leh legarmeh.
