Taninan, (Shemot 144 1) hay man dechame invin chivvavrin bechelma, siman yafe lo, uchame la. may tama, begin deihu raza ditren dargin yedian, inun uchame vechivvavre. hay ihu tav, vehay ihu dela tav, vechullehu invin beraza dimhemnuta talyayn. veal da mitparshan bechachmeta, hen letav, hen levish. illen tzerichin rachame, veillen ashgachuta derachame.

Ta chaze, adam harishon, inteteh sachata leh invin, vegarimat leh mota, ulechol yisrael, ulechol alma. noach ata lehanne invin, vela itnetar kedka yeut, ma ketiv, (bareasheytet) vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal betoch oholo, beHei. bene aharon, shatu chamra minnayyhu, vekarivu karbana behahu chamra, umitu, veha ittemar. uvegin kach ketiv, (Devarim 32:32) anavemo inve rosh ashkelot merorot lammo, begin deinun invin garme hay.

Chama invin deinun tavin, behahu kerem, deka salkin nayycha verecha bedargin shelemin, kedka yeut. veal da yosef yada milla, veistakkal beikkara, ufashar chelma al bureyeh. begin deitbassar behahu chelma, kedka yeut. uvegin kach pashar pishra letav, veitkeyyaym hachi.

Ma ketiv. vayyar sar haofim ki tov patar vayyomer el yosef af ani bachalomi vehinni shelosha salle chori al roshi. ta chaze, arurin inun rashshiaya, dechol ovadehon kullehon levish. vechol inun millin deinun amrin, kullehu levish, uleavasha.

Kevan defatach pumeh beaf, miyyad dachil yosef, veyada dechol milloy inun leavasha, uvesora devish befumeh. vehinni shelosha salle chori al roshi, keden yada yosef deitbassar al charivu deve makdesha, veyisrael begaluta, deyitgalun meara kaddisha.

Chame ma ketiv, uvassal haelyon mikkol maachal paro maase ofe vehaof ochel otam min hassal meal roshi. illen inun shear amin, demitkanshe alayyhu deyisrael, vekatle lon, vecharve vetayyhu, umefazzere lon learba sitre dealma. vecholla istakkal yosef, veyada dehahu chelma al yisrael, kad yehon bechiyyuva kamme malka, miyyad pashar leh pishra levish, veitkeyyaym beh.
Veta chaze, teren dargin illen, deka chama hay, vechama hay. da chama (deha)
383: Kad salik, veka shallit darga illaa, veitnehir sihara. veda chama, deitchashshach veshallit alah chivya visha. uvegin kach istakkal yosef behahu chelma, ufashar leh pishra levish. veal da, kolla befishra kayyma, veda veda chamu, beillen teren dargin, deshallit da, veshallit da.

Ribbi yehuda patach, (Tehillim 51:12) lev tahor bera li elohim veruach nachon chaddesh bekirbi, hay kera ukemuha, aval lev tahor, kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 3:9) venatatta leavdecha lev shomea vegomer, uchetiv (Mishlei 15:15) vetov lev mishte tamid, uvegin kach lev tahor vadday.

Veruach nachon chaddesh bekirbi, da hu ruach nachon vadday. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 1:2) veruach elohim merachefet al peni hammayim. veitaru, ze rucho shel mashiach. veitaru, (Yechezkel 11:19) veruach chadasha etten bekirbechem. vetzalle david, hahu ruach nachon, chaddesh bekirbi.

Begin deit missitra ochora, lev tame veruach ivim, deaste livne alma, veda hu ruach tumea, deikre ruach ivim. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 19:14) Adonai masach bekirbah ruach ivim. veal da veruach nachon chaddesh bekirbi. may chaddesh. da chiddusha desihara. beshata deitchaddash sihara, david melech yisrael chay vekayyaym uvegin kach chaddesh.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yose havu azle vearcha. amar ribbi yose leribbi elazar, hay dichtiv, (Melachim 1 22:21-22) vayyetze haruach vayyaamod lifne Adonai vayyomer ani afattennu vayyomer Adonai elav bemma vayyomer etze vehayiti ruach sheker befi kol neviav vayyomer tefatte vegam tuchol tze vaase chen. vetaninan dehava ruach navot hayyizreeli. vechi nishmatin, kevan desalkin vekayymin leela, inun yachlin leatava behay alma, umilla temiha, deamar etze vehayiti ruach sheker befi vegomer.

Vetu, may tama itanash aleh achav, deha dina deorayyta, deshavve shemuel kammayyhu deyisrael, hachi hu. dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 8:14) et sedotechem vecharmechem vezetechem hattovim yikkach. vei achav natal hahu kerm benavot, dina hava. vetu, dehava yahiv leh karma ochora, o dahava, vela vaa.

Amar leh, yaot shealt. ta chaze, hay ruach dekaamru deihu ruach denavot, hacha it leistakkala. vechi rucha denavot yachil lesalleka ulekayyeyma kammeh dekudesha berich hu, lemitba shikra. dichtiv vayyetze haruach. vei tzaddika hu, ech yibbae shikra behahu alma, deihu alma dikshot. uma behay alma, la vae zakkaa shikra, behahu alma, la chol shekken. vei lav zakkaa ihu, hech yachil lekayyma kamme kudesha berich hu.

Ella vadday navot lav zakkaa hava kol kach lekayyma kamme kudesha berich hu, ella rucha ochora hava, deshalta bealma. deda hu rucha dekayyma tadir vesalka kamme kudesha berich hu. veda hu deaste livni alma beshikra. uman deihu ragil beshikra, ishtaddal tadir beshikra. veal da amar etze vehayiti ruach sheker vegomer. veal da kudesha berich hu amar leh, tze vaase chen. puk mehacha, kema deukemuha dichtiv, (Tehillim 101:7) dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay. uvegin da ihu ruach sheker vadday.

Vetu, al ma dekatal leh lenavot venatal karma dileh, katula ammay katil leh. ella al dekatil leh bela dina, itannash. katal leh bela dina, venasiv karma dileh. uvegin kach ketiv, (Melachim 1 21:19) haratzachta vegam yarashta, veal da itannash. veta chaze, kamma inun bene nasha bealma, deaste lon hay ruach shikra beshikra. veshallit ihu bealma bechamma sitrin uvechamma ovadin, veha okimna mille.

Veal da david malka baa leistamra minneh, vvaa leafaka miggo mesaavu. dichtiv, (Tehillim 51:12) lev tahor bera li elohim veruach nachon chaddesh bekirbi. da hu ruach nachon, veochora ihu ruach sheker. veal da teren dargin inun, chad kaddisha, vechad mesaava.

Patach veamar, (Yoel 2:11) vaAdonai natan kolo lifne chelo ki rav meod machanihu vechi atzum ose devaro vegomer, hay kera ukemuha. aval vaAdonai, bechol atar hu uve dineh. natan kolo, da hu kala dichtiv, (Devarim 4:12) kol devarim. uchetiv hatam, (Shemot 4:10) lo ish devarim. man ish devarim. kema deat amer, (Devarim 33:1) ish haelohim. lifne chelo, illen inun yisrael.
Ki rav meod machanehu, kema deat amer (Iyov 25:3) hayesh mispar ligdudav.
384: Dechamma memannan ushelichan it leh lekudesha berich hu, vechullehu kayyme leastaa alayyhu deyisrael (zohar chodesh 33 begin leistaava lehu). veal da kudesha berich hu izdamman kammayyhu deyisrael begin lenatra lehu, vela yachilu lekatrega lehu.

Ki atzum ose devaro. man atzum, da hu zakkaa hahu deishtaddal beorayyta kaddisha yemama velele. davar acher ki atzum, da hu mekatrega deishtakkach kamme kudesha berich hu veihu takkifa kefarzela takkifa ketinara. ose devaro, denatil reshut milleela venatil nishmata mittatta.

Ki gadol yom Adonai venora meod umi yechilennu. deihu shallit al kolla, veillaa vetakkifa al kullehu, vechullehu techot shaltaneh. zakkain inun tzaddikayyay, dekudesha berich hu itrae behu tadir, lezakkaa lon lealma deate ulemechede lehu bechedu detzaddikayay dizminin lemechode beh bekudesha berich hu. dichtiv, (Tehillim Adonai:12) veyismechu chol chose vach leolam yeranninu vetasech alemo veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha. baruch Adonai leolam amen vamen:
385: Kullehu achidan begufa deilana. ubbegin kach man deishtaddal beorayyta, ihu achid becholla, veha ukemuha veittemar.

Vayhi mikketz, may mikketz. ribbi shimon amar, atar delet bah zechira, veda hu ketz dismala. may tama, begin dichtiv, (Bereshit 40:14) ki im zechartani ittecha kaasher yitav lach. vechi hachi itchaze leh leyosef tzaddika, deihu amar ki im zechartani ittecha. ella kevan deistakkal yosef bechelmeh. amar, vadday chelma dizchira ihu. veihu taa behay, deha beh bekudesha berich hu have cholla.

Veal da atar dehava beh nashyu kam kammeh, ma ketiv velo zachar sar hammashkim et yosef vayyishkachehu. kevan deamar velo zachar sar hammashkim, mahu vayyishkachehu. ella vayyishkachehu atar deit beh shichcha, veda hu ketz desitra dechoshech. shenatayim yamim, may shenatayim. detav darga, ledarga deit beh zechira.

Ufaro cholem vehinne omed al hayeor, da chelma deyosef hava. begin dechol nahar, deyosef hatztzaddik ihu. veraza da have, hay man dechame nahar bachalom, chame shalom. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:12) hinni note eleha kenahar shalom:

Vayhi mikketz shenatayim. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Mishlei 29:4) melech bammishpat yaamid eretz veish terumot yehersenna, ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma illaa, atkin kolla kedka yeut, veappik nehorin illain menaharin lechol sitrin, vecholla ihu chad. uvara shamayim dilela veeretz dilela, leittakna kullehu kechada, letoalta detattae.

Ta chaze, melech bammishpat yaamid eretz. man melech, da kudesha berich hu. bammishpat, da yaakov, deihu kiyyuma deara. veal da, 6 ittezan min Adonai illaa, Adonai tattaa ittezanat min 6, dekiyyuma deara ihu bemishpat. deha mishpat yaamid ertz bechol tikkunoy, vezan lah.

Davar acher, melech, da kudesha berich hu. bammishpat, da yosef. yaamid eretz, dichtiv (Bereshit 41:57) vechol haaretz bau mitzrayma lishbor el yosef. uvegin dekudesha berich hu itrae beh beyaakov, avad leh leyosef shallita al ara.

Ribbi yose amar, melech, da yosef. bammishpat yaamid eretz, da yaakov. deha ad la ata yaakov lemitzrayim, la hava kiyyuma beara, miggo kafna. kevan deata yaakov lemitzrayim, bizchuteh istallak kafna, veitkeyyaym ara.

Davar acher, melech bammishpat yaamid eretz, da david malka, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 8:15) vayhi david ose mishpat utzedaka lechol ammo, veihu kiyyem ara, uvizchuteh kayyma levatar dena. veish terumot yehersenna, da rechavam.

Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu beginehon detzaddikaya, af al gav defureanuta itgezar al alma, mitakkeva beginehon vela shalta al alma. kol yomoy dedavid malka itkayyma ara begineh, levatar demit itkayyma bizchuteh. dichtiv, (Melachim 2 20:6) vegannoti al hair hazzot lehoshiah lemaani ulemaan david avdi. kegavvna da, kol yomoy deyaakov vechol yomoy deyosef, la shalta pureanuta bealma.

Ta chaze, melech bammishpat yaamid eretz, da yosef. veish terumot yehersenna, da paro. deha begin deakshe libbeh legabbe dekudesha berich hu, chariv ara demitzrayim. uvekadmita al yeda deyosef itkeyyaym ara behahu chelma dechalam. dichtiv, vayhi mikketz shenatayim yamim vegomer.

Vayhi mikketz vegomer. ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Tehillim 18:47) chay Adonai uvaruch tzuri veyarum elohe yishi. elohe ketiv, bevyv. hay kera it leistakkala beh. chay Adonai, da chay tzaddika yesoda dealma, deikre chay dealmin. uvaruch tzuri, da (sefer acher hod) hu dichtiv (Tehillim 144:1) baruch Adonai tzuri, veda alma deitkeyyaym aleh tzaddika da. veyarum elohe yishi. veyarum da alma illaa. elohe beVav, da shamayim, kema deat amer, (tehillim 116) hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai.
Ta chaze, (kema deat amar) (Tehillim 68:20) baruch adonay yom yom yaamas lanu. baruch adonay, beAlef dalet nun yod, vehay kera raza dechachmeta ihu. yom yom, ellu shenatayim yamim, kema deat amer
386: Vayhi mikketz shenatayim yamim ufaro cholem vehinne omed al hayeor, raza ihu, kema deittemar da yosef. denahar (sefer acher dechol nahar) da, yosef hatztzaddik hu.

Vehinne min hayeor olot sheva parot yefot mare uveriot basar vattirena baachu. vehinne min hayeor, deha minnahar da itbarchan kol inun dargin diltatta. begin dehahu nahar denagid venafik, ihu ashke vezan lecholla. veyosef ihu nahar, leitbarcha kol ara demitzrayim begineh.

Veta chaze, hahu nahar, sheva dargin itshakyayn veitbarchan minneh, veillen inun yefot mare uveriot basar. vattirena baachu, bechibbura beachvavta dela ishtakkach behu piruda. vechullehu leshabbacha kayymin, deha kol hanne dargin sheva dekaamaran, raza ihu. kema deat amer, (Ester 2:9) veet sheva hannearot haruyot latet lah mibbet hammelech vegomer. veal da sheva parot yefot mare, velokovel da ketiv shivat hassarisim hameshartim et pene hammelech vegomer.
Ribbi yitzchak amar, sheva parot hattovot, dargin inun illain al ochoranin. vesheva happarot haraot, dargin ochoranin diltatta. illen missitra dikdusha, veillen missitra dimsaava.

Sheva hashshibbolim, ribbi yehuda amar, illen kodamay inun tavin, begin deinun missitra dimina dichtiv beh ki tov. veillen bishin inun letatta minnayyhu. sheva hashshibbolim inun missitra dedachyu, veillen missitra dimsaavu, vechullehu dargin kayymin illen al illen, veillen lokovel illen, vechullehu ka chama paro bechelmeh.

Amar ribbi yesa, vechi lehahu chayyayva defaro achzeyayn leh kol hanni. amar leh ribbi yehuda, kegavvna dilhon chama. dechamma dargin al dargin, illen lokovel illen, veillen al illen, veihu chama beinun dargin diltatta.

Veha taninan, deha kema deihu bar nash, hachi achzeyu leh bechelmeh, vehachi chame. venishmata hachi salkat leishtemoda. kol chad vechad kefum dargeh kedka chaze leh, uvegin kach paro chama kedka chaze leh, vela yattir:

Vayhi mikketz vegomer, ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Kohelet 3:1) lakkol zeman veet lechol chefetz tachat hashshamayim. ta chaze, kol ma deavad kudesha berich hu letatta, lecholla shavve zimna uzeman katzuv. zeman shavve linhora velachashocha, zimna shavve linhora dishar ammin, deinun shaltin hasheta al alma. vezimna shavve lachashocha, deihu galuta deyisrael techot shaltanuta dilhon. zimna shavve kudesha berich hu lecholla, vegin kach lakkol zeman veet lechol chefetz. may veet lechol chefetz. zimna veiddan hu lecholla, lechol hahu reuta deishtakkach letatta.

Davar acher veet lechol chefetz, may et. kedichtiv, (Tehillim 119:126) et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha. uchetiv, (Vayikra 17) veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh. veihu darga memanna, veha ukemuha. uvegin kach et ihu memanna, lechol chefetz tachat hashshamayim. vayhi mikketz shenatayim yamim, missitra dehahu ketz dechoshech chama paro bechelmeh, umittamman yada veitgeli leh hahu chelma.

Vayhi vabboker vattippaem rucho vayyishlach vayyikra et kol chartumme mitzrayim veet kol chachameha vegomer. vattippaem rucho. may vattippaem. ribbi yose amar, ha ukemuha befaro ketiv vattippaem, uvinvuchadnetztzar ketiv, (Daniel 2:4) vattitpaem, veukemuha deha befaro ketiv vattippaem, begin dehava yada chelma, ufishra la hava yada, aval nevuchadnetztzar, chama chelma, vechama pishra, veitneshe kolla minneh.

Aval ta chaze, vattippaem rucho, kema deat amer, (Shoftim 13) lefaamo, dehava ate rucha veazil, veate veazil. vela hava mityayshva immeh adayin kedka yeut. veal da ketiv, (Shoftim 13:25) vattachel ruach Adonai lefaamo, dichden hava sheruta. uf hacha rucheh itar beh, veazil veitar, vela hava mityashsheva immeh leminda. nevuchadnetztzar vattitpaem rucho, beitaruta hava itar al chad terin, (tayyvin) veazlin vetayyvin, veda hu kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 24:1) kefaam befaam. paam behay,
387: Ufaam behay, vela mityashsheva dateh verucheh.
Vayyishlach vayyikra et kol chartume mitzrayim, illen chorashin. veet kol chachameha, illen chakkimin betayyra, vechullehu havu mistakkelan leminda velo yachilu leadbaka.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, af al gav deittemar dela achzeyayn leh levar nash ella behahu darga dileh, shani limlachim, deachzeyayn lon millin illain, umeshanyayn mibbene nasha ochoranin. kema demalka dargeh illaa al kol shear ochoranin, hachi name achaziu leh bedarga illaa al kol shear ochoranin. kema deat amer et asher haelohim ose hera et paro. (238 1) aval lishar bene nasha, la gale lon kudesha berich hu ma deihu avad, bar linvie o lachaside o lechakkime dara, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, ketiv, oti heshiv al kanni veoto tala, mikkan dechelma azil batar pishra. heshiv al kanni man, ella da yosef. veoto tala, behahu pishra deka pashar leh, uchetiv vayhi kaasher patar lanu ken haya:

Vayyishlach paro vayyikra et yosef vayritzuhu min habbor vegomer. ribbi abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 147:11) rotze Adonai et yereav et hameyachalim lechasdo. kamma kudesha berich hu, itrae behu betzaddikaya, begin detzaddikaya inun avdin (shelama veavde) shelama leela, veavde shelama letatta, veoolin kalla bevaalah. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu itrae behu, beinnun dedachalin leh veavdin reuteh.

Lamyachalim lechasdo, man inun meyachalim lechasdo. hve ema inun demishtaddele beorayyta belelya, veishtattefu bahade shechinta. vechad ate tzafra, inun mechakkan lechasdo. veha ukemuha, bezimna devar nash ishtaddal beorayyta belelya, chuta dechesed itmeshich aleh bimama. kedichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvalayla shiro immi. may tama yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo, mishshum devallayla shiro immi. ubbegin kach rotze Adonai et yereav ketiv, velo vireav. keman derae biruteh leachara, veitree leh leitpayysa bahadeh. uvegin kach rotze Adonai et yereav, velo bireav.

Kegavvna da, yosef hava atziv baatzivu derucha, baatzivu delibba, dehava asir tamman. kevan deshaddar paro begineh, ma ketiv. vayritzuhu, itpayysu leh veahadaru leh millin dechedva, millin lemechede libba, begin dehava atziv min bera. ta chaze, bekadmita nafal bevera, bevera istallak levatar.

Ribbi shimon amar, ad la era leyosef hahu ovada, la ikre tzaddik. kevan denatar hahu berit kayyayma, ikre tzaddik. vehahu darga divrit kaddisha itattar bahadeh, umay dehava (avid) babbor bekadmita, istallak bahadeh, uchetiv vayritzuhu min habbor. istallak min da, veitattar biver mayim chayyim.

Vayyishlach paro vayyikra et yosef, likro leyosef mibbae leh. ella vayyikra et yosef, da kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 105:19) ad et bo devaro imrat Adonai tzerafathu. ad et bo devaro, hada hu dichtiv vayykra et yosef, ketiv hacha vayyikra et yosef, uchetiv hatam vayyikra el moshe: vaygallach vaychallef simlotav, begin yekara demalka, veha ukemuha.

Ribbi elazar patach, (Tehillim 105:23) vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim veyaakov gar beeretz cham. ta chaze, dekudesha berich hu megalgel gilgulin bealma, umekayyem esarin vekiyyumin, begin lekayyma kiyyuma ugezera deihu gazir.

Deha tenan, illemale chavivu urechimu derachim kudesha berich hu laavahan, hava itchaze lenachata yaakov lemitzrayim beshalshele defarzela. uvirchimu dilhon, shalteh leyosef bereh, veavad leh malka deshallita al kol ara, venachatu kullehu shivtin bikara, veyaakov kemalka.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim veyaakov gar beeretz cham, kevan dichtiv vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim, la yedana deyaakov gar beeretz cham, ammay itzterich ha. ella vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim, da kudesha berich hu. veyaakov gar beeretz cham, da yaakov, deha begineh deyaakov uvenoy, ata shechinta lemitzrayim. vekudesha berich hu gilgel gilgulin,
388: Veachit leh leyosef bekadmita. devizchuteh itkeyyaym berit bahadeh, veshalteh al kol ara.

Ma ketiv, shalach melech vayyattirehu moshel ammim vayfattechehu. ribbi shimon amar, ketiv, (Tehillim 146:7) Adonai mattir asurim vegomer, (veha) vehacha ketiv, shalach melech vayyattirehu, ammay moshel ammim vayfattechehu. ella, shalach melech, da kudesha berich hu. moshel ammim, da kudesha berich hu. shalach melech, melech illaa shalach vayyattiyirihu, uman ihu deshalach (leh), da malach haggoel, deihu moshel ammim, deihu moshel al tattae. vecholla meim kudesha berich hu ihu.

Vayritzuhu chaser vav, uman ihu, da kudesha berich hu. begin deha let man deasir ufattach, bar kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Iyov 12:14) yisgor al ish velo yippateach. uchetiv, (Iyov la) vehu yashkit umi yarshia veyaster panim umi yeshurennu veal goy veal adam yachad, deha kolla beh. uchetiv, (Daniel 4:32) uchemitzbeye aved bechel shemaya vedayyre ara vela itay di yemache videh veyemar leh ma avadt. uvegin kach ketiv, vayritzuhu min habbor vegomer.

May vayritzuhu. kema deat amer, (Iyov 33:26) yetar el eloah vayyirtzehu. kegavvna da vayritzuhu min habbor, ulevatar vayyavo el paro. davar acher vayritzuhu, deamshich aleh chuta dechesed, lemehav leh chinna kammeh defaro. (45 ketiv), elohim yaane et shelom paro, begin leakdama leh shalom ulemiftach beshalom.

Ribbi abba amar, ta chaze, behahu rasha defaro. deihu amar, (Shemot Adonai:2) lo yadati et Adonai, ufaro chakkim hava mikkol chorashoy. ella vadday shema deelohim hava yada, deha ketiv, hanimtza chaze ish asher ruach elohim bo. uvegin demoshe la ata legabbeh ella bishma daAdonai velo bishma deelohim. veda hava kashya kameh mikkolla, deihu hava yada deha shema da ihu shallit beara. uvishma daAdonai la hava yada, veal da kashya kammeh shema da.
Veda hu dichtiv (Shemot 9:12) vaychazek Adonai et lev paro, demilla da hava atkif libbeh, veakshe leh. veal da moshe lo oda leh milla dishma ochora, ela shema daAdonai bilchodoy, veukemuha.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 113:5) mi kaAdonai elokenu hammagbihi lashavet vegomer. mi kaAdonai elokenu hammagbihi lashavet, deistallak meal karse yekareh, (sefer acher al karse yekareh leella) vela itgeli letatta. beshata dela ishtakkachu zakkain bealma, ha ihu istallak minnayyhu, vela itgeli lehu. hammashpili lirot, beshata dezakkain inun deishtakkachu bealma. kudesha berich hu nachit bedargoy lekivlehon detattae, leashgacha al alma, leotava lehu.
Deha kad zakkain la ishtakkachu bealma, ihu istallak, veastir anpin minnayyhu, velo ashgach alayyhu. begin detzaddikayyay inun yesoda vekiyyuma dealma, dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam.

Veal da kudesha berich hu la galle shemeh kaddisha, bar leyisrael bilchodoy, deinun chulak adveh veachsanteh. vealma palig leh kudesha berich hu limmannan terisin, veha ittemar. dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) behanechel elyon goyim vegomer. uchetiv, ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.
Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havu azle vearcha. amar ribbi yose leribbi chiyyay, tevavhna al hay dekaamar shelomo, kol milloy (milin) setimin vela ityaydun, deha kohelet satim (milin) setimin.

Patach veamar, (Kohelet 1:8) kol haddevarim yegeim lo yuchal ish ledabber lo tisba ayin lirot velo timmale ozen mishmoa. kol haddevarim yegeim, vechi kol haddevarim yegeim inun lemallala, dekaamar lo yuchal ish ledabber. velo tisba ayin lirot velo timmale ozen mishmoa, may tama illen. ella begin ditren minhon, veinun ayynin veudenin, la kayyaymin birshuteh devar nash, ufuma ihu birshuteh. vechol (45) illen telat la yachlin leashlama kolla, uleadbaka kolla.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, hachi hu, dedibbura devar nash la yachil lemallala, veayynin lemecheme, veudenin lemishma, veen kol chadash tachat hashshemesh. veta chaze, afilu biryayn vekastorin, deavad kudesha berich hu tachat hashshemesh, la yachlin lemallala kol millin dealma, veena la yachil
389: Lemishlat ulemechome, veudena lemishma. uvegin kach shelomo dehava yada kol milla, hava amar da.

Veta chaze, kol ovadin dealma, bechamma kasterin talyayn, vechol bene alma la yadin, vela mashgichin al ma kayyme bealma, veafillu shelomo malka, dehava chakkim mikkol bene alma, la yachil lekayyma behu.

Patach veamar, (Kohelet 3:11) et hakkol asa yafe beitto gam et haolam natan belibbam mibbeli asher lo yimtza haadam et hammaase asher asa haelohim vegomer. ta chaze, zakkain inun demishtaddele beorayyta veyade leistakkala berucha (sefer acher beraza) dechachmata. et hakkol asa yafe beitto, kol ovadin deavad kudesha berich hu bealma, bechol ovada veovada, it darga memanna al hahu ovada bealma, hen letav hen levish. minnehon dargin limina, uminhon dargin lismala. azil bar nash limina, hahu ovada deavid, hahu darga memanna (sefer acher dimina) lehahu sitra, (avide) veavid leh siyyua, vechamma inun dimsayye leh. azal bar nash lismala, veavid ovadoy, hahu ovada deavid, memanna (sefer acher darga dismala) ihu lehahu sitra, veka mekatreg leh, veovil leh lehahu sitra, veaste leh. ubbegin kach hahu ovada deavid bar nash kedka chaze, hahu memanna distar yemina ka mesayyea leh. veda hu beitto, yafe beitto, dehahu ovada mitkashshera beitto, kedka chaze leh.

Gam et haolam natan belibbam. kol alma, vechol ovadoy dealma, lav inun ella biruta delibba, kad salik biruta (delibba, vechad salik biruta) devar nash. zakkain innun tzaddikayya deamshichu ovadin tavin, leotava lon ulechol alma, veinun yadin leitdabbeka beet shalom. uvechela ditzdaka deavdin letatta, inun mashchin lehahu darga deikre kol, leanhara beitto.
Vavy lon lechayyayvaya dela yadin et dehahu ovada, vela mashgichin lemebad ovadehon bealma al tikkuna deitzterich leh lealma. uleatkana ovada behahu darga deitchaze leh. may tama, begin dela yadin.

Veal da ityeyhiv kolla birutehon divne nasha. dichtiv, mibbeli asher lo yimtza haadam et hammaase asher asa haelohim merosh vead sof. uvegin kach deinun ovadin la itavidu leatkana bedargayyhu kidkachaze, deyitkelil ovada da bedarga da, kolla ketikkuna ella kefum reuta devar nash. ma ketiv batreh yadati ki en tov bam ki im lismoach velaasot tov bechayyav. yadati ki en tov bam, beinun ovadin, dela itavidu kedka yeut. ki im lismoach, bechol ma deyete aloy, ulemehav hodaa lekudesha berich hu. velaasot tov bechayyav, deha i hahu ovada garim leh bisha, begin hahu darga deka memanna aloy, it leh lemechode beh, uleodaa aleh. deihu garim leh lenafsheh, veihu azil bela yedia, ketzifora da bego kusetira.

Vechol da menalan, dichtiv, (kahelatet) ki gam lo yeda haadam et itto, kaddagim shenneechazim bimtzoda raa vechatztzipporim haachuzot bappach kahem yukashim bene haadam leet raa keshettippol alehem pitom. ki gam lo yada haadam et itto. may itto, itto dehahu ovada deka avid. kema deat amer, et hakkol asa yafe beitto, uvegin kach inun katztzipporim haachuzot bappach. uvegin kach zakkain inun demishtaddele beorayyta, veyade orchoy usheviloy deorayyta demalka illaa, lemehach bah beorach keshot.

Veta chaze, leolam al yiftach bar nash pumeh levish, deihu la yada man natil hahi milla. vechad la yada bar nash itkeshal bah. vetzaddikaya kad patche pumayyhu kullehu shelam. ta chaze, yosef kad shara lemallala lefaro. ma ketiv, elohim yaane et shelom paro. amar ribbi yehuda, ha ittemar. dekudesha berich hu chas al shelama demalchuta, kema deat amer, (Shemot 6:13) vaytzavvim el beni yisrael veel paro melech mitzrayim
390: Ribbi chiyyay amar, paro baa lenassaa leh leyosef, veachlaf leh chelma. veyosef begin dehava yada dargin, istakkal bechol milla umilla. veamar, kach chamita, kol milla umilla kedka chaze.

Hada hu dichtiv vayyomer paro el yosef achare hodia elohim otcha et kol zot en navon vechacham kamocha. achare hodia elohim, acharay havet behahi shata dachalamit chelma, tamman havet shechiach. uvegin kach amar (sefer acher emet et kol zot yadata, veech yadata pishreh) et kol zot yadat chelma hech hava, veyadat pishreh.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, i hachi yosef amar kolla, chelma ufishra. kedaniyyel deamar chelma ufishreh. amar leh, lav hay kehay (15 33 deha). yosef istakkal miggo millula defaro dehava amar bedargin yedian, vechama leh deka taa, veamar leh lav hachi, ella hachi hu. begin dedargin kesidran atyayn. aval daniyyel la istakkal miggo millula dinvuchadnetztzar kelum. (dela) vecholla kaamar leh chelma ufishreh.
Ma ketiv bedaniyyel, (Daniel 2:19) edayin ledaniyyel bechezva di lelya raza gali bechezva di lelya. man chezva di lelya, da gavriel, deihu chezva chezu min chezu.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Yechezkel 43:2) vehinne kevod eloke yisrael ba midderech hakkadim vekolo kekol mayim rabbim vehaaretz heira mikkevodo. ma ketiv batreh, uchemare hammare asher raiti bevoi leshachet et hair umarot kammare asher raiti el nehar kevar vaeppol el panay. kol illen marot, inun shit, deinun marot vechezu dechezva. chezu it leh, leitchazaa beh gevavnin dilela, veitchazun behahu chezu. veit chezu lechezu, vechezu lechezu, da al da. vechullehu kayymin bedargin yedian veshalte, veikrun chezu delelya, uvehu mitparshin kol chelmin dealma, veillen inun kegavvna dilela alayyhu.

Ubbegin kach daniyyel bechezva delelya raza gali. itgeli la ketiv, ella raza gali, chad meillen dargin, galle leh hahu chelma ufishreh. aval yosef, miggo milloy defaro, istakkal bedargin illain vekaamar.

Uvegin kach pakdeh al kol ara demitzrayim, begin dekudesha berich hu, middileh deyosef ka yahiv leh. puma dela nashak laavera, ketiv veal picha yishshak kol ami. yada dela kariv laavera, ketiv vayyitten otah al yad yosef. tzavvar dela kariv laavera, ketiv vayyasem revid hazzahav al tzavvaro. gufa dela kariv laavera, vayyalbesh oto bigde shesh. regel dela rachiv laavera, ketiv vayyarkev oto bemirkevet hammishne asher lo. hammachashava dela chashav, nikra navon vechacham. lev shello hirher, vayyikreu lefanav avrech. vecholla middileh natal.

Ma ketiv. vayyetze yosef millifni faro vayyaavor bechol eretz mitzrayim. amar ribbi chizkiyya, may tama vayyaavor bechol eretz mitzrayim. begin leshaltaa, demachreze kamme hachi. uvegin lemichnash ibbura bechol atar vaatar. ribbi elazar amar, kanash yosef ibbur bechol atar, begin dela yitrakkav.

Amar ribbi shimon, kol ma deavad kudesha berich hu, kolla ihu legalgela gilgulin, begin devae lekayyma kiyyuma. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, ayyte kol ma deitzterich alma bekadmita, ulevatar ayyte leh levar nash lealma, veashkach mezona.

(15 33 401 Chaze) kegavvna da, kudesha berich hu amar leavraham, (Bereshit 15:13) yadoa teda ki ger yihye zaracha beeretz lo lahem vegomer, veachare chen yetzu birchush gadol. kad ata yosef leara demitzrayim, la ishtechach bah rechush gadol. gilgel gilgulin, veayyte kafna al alma. vechol alma havu mayytin kaspa vedahava lemitzrayim, veitmele chol ara demitzrayim kaspa vedahava. levatar deittakkan kolla rechush gadol, ayyte yaakov lemitzrayim.
Dehachi arche dekudesha berich hu, bekadmita bare (sefer acher ak1dayyam) asvavta, ulevatar mache. kach bekadmita atkin rechush gadol, ulevatar
391: Ayyte lon legaluta. veal da gilgel gilgulin veayyte kafna al kol alma, begin delehvu mayytin kaspa vedahava kol alma lemitzrayim.

Ta chaze, begin (kach) yosef deihu tzaddik, ihi garim utera kaspa vedahava, lenatla yisrael. kedichtiv, (Tehillim 105:37) vayyotziem bechesef vezahav veen bishvatav koshel. umin yeda detzaddik, ata da leyisrael. vecholla lemizke lon lealma deate.

Patach veamar, (Kohelet 9:9) ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta vegomer. ta chaze, hay kera beraza illaa ihu, veukemuha. ree chayyim, illen chayyin dealma deate, dezachaa hu bar nash dezache beh kedka yeut.

Im ishsha asher ahavta, da keneset yisrael, begin devah ketiv ahava. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:3) veahavat olam ahavticha, ematay. beshata desitra dimina achid bah. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:3) al ken meshachtich chased.

(Kohelet 9:9) kol yeme chayye hevlecha, begin deihi itkashsherat bachayyim, veihi olam dechayyin sharyayn beh. deha alma da, la sharyayn beh chayyim. begin deinun tachat hashshemesh, vela matan hacha inun nehorin dehahu shimsha, veistallaku mealma miyyoma deitchariv be makdesha. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 13:10) chashach hashshemesh betzeto vegomer. may chashach hashshemesh, desalik nehoreh vela nahir. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad vegomer.
Ki hu chelkecha bachayyim, da hu shimsha besihara, uveinan lemeal sihara beshimsha veshimsha besihara, dela leafrasha lon. veda hu chulaka devar nash, lemeal behu lealma deate.

Ma ketiv batreh, (Kohelet 9:10) kol asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase ki en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bashol asher atta holech shamma. hay kera it leistakkala beh. kol asher timtza yadcha laasot, vechi huttera retzua lemebad bar nash kol ma deyachil. ella, laasot bechochacha ketiv, may bechochacha. da nishmateh devar nash, deihi chela devar nash, lemizke vah lealma den ulealma deate.
Davar acher bechochacha, da hi ishsha dekaamaran, deihi chela leittakfa bah, bealma den uvealma deate. uvae bar nash lemizke vah behay alma behay chela, begin deyittakkaf bah behahu alma.

May tama. begin dilvatar deyippuk bar nash mehay alma, let beh chela lemebad middi velomar, hasheta, mikkan ulehala aavid ovadin tavin. devadday en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bashol asher vegomer. i la zache bar nash behay alma, la yizke beh levatar behahu alma. veukemuha, man dela atkin zevavdin lemehach mehay alma, la yechul behahu alma. veit ovadin tavin deavid bar nash behay alma, deyechul minnayyhu hacha. vecholla ishtaar lealma deate uleittezna minnayyhu.

Ta chaze, yosef zacha behay alma vezacha bealma deate, begin devaa leitachada beishsha yirat Adonai. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 39:9) vechatati lelohim. uvegin kach zacha lemishlat behay alma, vezacha lon leyisrael.

Ma ketiv, (Bereshit 47:14) vaylakket yosef et kol hakkesef. vehachi itchaze, deha hahu nahar denagid venafik, ihu lakit kolla, vechol utera beh kayyma. veda hi raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:17) vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim, vecholla ihu kedka yeut, vadday yosef bae lemishlat al malchuta.

Veta chaze, ketiv, vayyarkev oto bemirkevet hammishne. man mirkevet hammishne. kudesha berich hu avid leh latztzaddik shallita, begin deha minneh ittezan alma, veitzterich leittezana. vekudesha berich hu it leh reticha illaa, veit leh reticha tattaa. reticha tattaa ihi mirkevet hammishne, veyosef tzaddik ikre, veleh itchaze lemehve rachiv al mirkevet hammishne asher lo, lekudesha berich hu. vecholla ihu beraza ilaa, lemeheve kegavvna dilela.
Ta chaze, vayyikreu lefanav avrech, may avrech. keshiru deitkkashshar shimsha besihara, vecholla karin lokovel atar da. venaton oto al kol alma, vechullehu odan legabbeh,
392: Uvegin da kolla beraza illaa ihu.

Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu avad malchuta deara, keen malchuta dirkia, vecholla da kegavvna da. vechol ma deitavid beara kayyma kamme kudesha berich hu bekadmita. ta chaze, malchuta kaddisha, la kabbil malchuta shelemata, ad deitchabbar baavahan. begin dekudesha berich hu avad lah lemalchu illaa, leitnahara meraza deavahan.

Vechad yosef hatztzaddik nachat lemitzrayim bekadmita, ihu mashich lah lishchinta levatar immeh, deha shechinta la azla ella batra detzaddik. uvegin kach itmeshach yosef lemitzrayim bekadmita, venatil kol utera dealma kedka yeut, ulevatar nachatat shechinta lemitzrayim, vechullehu shivtin bahadah.

Uvegine kach, yosef denatar leh labberit, zacha leitattera beatreh, vezacha lemalchuta dilela, ulemalchuta diltatta. veal da kol man denatar berit kaddisha, keillu kiyyem orayyta kaddisha kola, deha berit shakil kechol orayyta:

Vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim vayyomer yaakov levanav vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Zecharya 12:1) massa devar Adonai al yisrael neum Adonai note shamayim veyosed aretz veyotzer ruach adam bekirbo. hay kera it leistakkala beh. massa devar Adonai, bechol hanne atar dekaamar massa, massa ammay. ella, bechol atar deihu al dina dishar ammin veamar massa, letav. bechol atar deihu al yisrael veamar massa, levish.

Bechol atar deihu al dina dishar amin, letav. begin demassa matula ihu. kivyachol matula ihu aleh dekudesha berich hu, shalom deammin ovde kochavim umazzalot. vechad itgezar dina alayyhu maavar minneh hahu matula deihu savil alayyhu. bechol atar dedina itgezar alayyhu deyisrael, veamar massa, kivyachol matula ihu aleh dekudesha berich hu. ubbegin kach massa mehay gisa, umehay gisa, matula ihu.

Kevan deamar note shamayim veyosed aretz, ammay itzterich veyotzer ruach adam bekirbo. vechi la havena yade deihu yotzer ruach adam. ella leachazaa darga yedia, dechol ruchin venishmatin dealma, behahu darga kayymin.

Ribbi shimon amar, hay kera kashya, i amar veyotzer ruach adam vela yattir yaot, aval bekirbo mahu. ella raza ihu bitren sitrin, deha mehahu nahar denagid venafik, mittamman nafke ufarche nishmatin kullehu, veitkenishu beatar chad. vehahu darga ihu yotzer ruach adam bekirbo. vehay keitteta deitabbera min dechura, vehahu velada tzarat lah bimaha. ad deitztayyer kolla betziyyura shelimu bimaha. kach veyotzer ruach adam bekirbo, bekirbo kayyma. ad deitbere bar nash bealma veyahiv leh.

Davar acher, veyotzer ruach adam bekirbo, bekirbo deadam mammash. begin dechad itbere var nash, vekudesha berich hu yahav leh nishmateh, venafik laavira dealma. hahu rucha divgavveh, la ashkach gufa leitpashsheta begavveh, vekayyma besitra chad begavveh.

Vechad bar nash itpashat gufeh, hahu rucha itpashshat, veyahiv beh chela, vechen kegavvna degufa itrabbe, hachi rucha yahiv chela beh, leittakkefa bar nash bahadeh. uvegin kach yotzer ruach adam bekirbo mammash.
Vei tema yotzer ruach adam mahu, begin dehahu rucha, itzterich chela dilela yattir leistayya bahadeh. veal da kudesha berich hu ihu yotzer ruach adam bekirbo, veyahiv leh siyyua bevar nash.

Ta chaze, kad hahu rucha itzterich siyyua, kegavvna deihu hahu bar nash, uchegavvna dehahu gufa ittakkan, hachi name hahu rucha metaknin leh, veosfin leh rucha leittakkena. veda hu yotzer ruach adam bekirbo.
Veta chaze, kevan deitavid yosef meavoy, yaakov avid hahu tosefet rucha dehava leh, veistallekat minneh shechinta. levatar ma ketiv, (Bereshit 45:27) vattechi ruach yaakov avihem. vechi ad hasheta
393: Mit hava. ella hahu tosefet rucha istallak minneh shechinta, vela hava begavveh. begin deitzvona dehava beh garma leh, (vei garma leh ha) (sefer acher dela) la hava rucheh bekiyyumeh. uvegin kach vattechi ruach yaakov avihem.
Vehacha (ketiv vayyar yaakov), dead kean la itbassar, mena hava yada. ella vayyar yaakov, dechama lechol dayyre ara deazle lemitzrayim, umayytan ibbura (hada hu dichtiv vayyar yaakov).
Ribbi yitzchak amar, ta chaze, david malka zacha leitchabbera baavahan, veyarit ducheteh begavvavyyhu. hada hu dichtiv, even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pinna.

(Nidpas vaere lo 1) ribbi yesa veribbi chizkiyya havu azle mikkappotkiyya lelod, vehava immehon chad yuday bematul dekaftira dechamra, ad dehavu azle, amar ribbi yesa leribbi chizkiyya, aftach pumach veema chad milla meinun mile maalyayta deorayyta, deat amer bechol yoma kamme butzina kaddisha.

Patach veamar, (Mishlei 3:17) deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom. deracheha darche noam, illen archin deorayyta. deman deazil bearche deorayyta, kudesha berich hu ashre aleh neimuta dishchinta, di la taade minneh lealmin. vechol netivoteha shalom, dechullehu netivin deorayyta kullehu shelam, shelam leh leela, shelam leh letatta. shelam leh bealma den, shelam leh bealma deate.

Amar hahu yuday, isira (asetarea) bekistera behay kera ishtakkach, amru leh, minayin lach. amar lon, meabba shemana, veolifna hacha behay kera milla (tava). patach veamar, hay kera bitren gevavnin ihu, uvitren sitrin. kare beh derachim, vekare beh netivot. kare beh noam, vekare beh shalom. man derachim, uman netivot. man noam, uman shalom.

Ella deracheha darche noam. hayeynu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam darech, deha bechol atar deikre beorayyta derech, hu orach peticha lecholla. kehay archa, deihu petiach lechol bar nash. kach deracheha darche noam, ilen derachim deinun petichan meavahan, decharan beyamma rabba, vealin begavveh, umeinun orchin mitpattechin lechol evar ulechol sitre alma.

Vehay noam, hu neimu denafak mealma deate. umealma deate naharin kol butzinin, umitparshan lechol evar. vehahu tivu vehahu nehora dealma deate, deyankin (nusach acher deyartin) avahan, ikre noam. davar acher, alma deate ikre noam, vechad itar alma deate, kol chedu vechol tivu vechol nehorin vechol cheru dealma itar, uvegini kach ikre noam.

Veal da taninan, chayyayvin degehinnom, beshata deal shabbatta, nayychin kullehu, veit lehu cherut venayycha. beshata denafik shabbatta, it lan leitara chedu illaa alana, denishteziv mehahu onasha dechayyayvaya deitdanu (sefer acher daahaderav) mehahi shata ulehala. veit lan leitara velema, (Tehillim 90:17) vihi noam Adonai elokenu alenu. da hu noam illaa, chedu (sefer acher cheru) decholla, veal da deracheha darche noam.

Vechol netivoteha shalom, man netivoteha. illen inun shevilin denafkin milleela, vechullehu nakit lon berit yechiday, deihu ikre shalom, shelama deveta. veail lon leyama rabba, kad ihu betukefeh, ucheden yahiv leh shelama. hada hu dichtiv vechol netivoteha shalom (ad kan). ta chaze, yosef berit shalom hava, vehava bemitzrayim malka, veshallit al ara. veyaakov begin deistallak minneh shechinta, la hava yada.

Veim kol da, yaakov hava leh tavra, begin lemizban ibbura bemitzrayim. vechama deihu tevira al tevira, deyechatun benoy lemitzrayim. vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau, begin dela tachamun gufayychu, ella kirevin, keguverin delet lon sava.
Amar ribbi chizkiyya, vadday raza hacha. deha bechol zimna detzaara ihu bealma, la bae bar nash, leachazaa garmeh beshuka, begin dela yittafes bechovoy. veal da amar lamma titrau, veha ittemar.
Davar acher vayyar yaakov ki yesh
394: Shever bemitzrayim, ibbur mammash. deha kudesha berich hu al da shaddar kafna bealma, begin lenachata leyaakov uvenoy letamman, veal da chama bene ara, dehavu mayytin mittamman ibbur.

Vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim, beshata demit yitzchak, atu yaakov veesav lemiflag. veesav nafak mechulakeh deara umikkolla, veyaakov deyisbol galuta yittol kolla. veal da chama hahu tevira dehava leh bemitzrayim, hu uvenoy lemisbal galuta. veal da vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau. mikkame dina dilela, dela yishtakkach alayychu mekatrega. vayyomer hinne shamati ki yesh shever bemitzrayim redu shamma. ha ukemuha 210, chusheban da havu yisrael bemitzrayim:

Veyosef hu hashshallit al haaretz vegomer, ribbi yesa patach veamar, (Tehillim 27:6) veatta yarum roshi al oyvay sevivotay veezbecha beoholo zivche terua ashira vaazammera laAdonai. ta chaze, kad kudesha berich hu itrae beh bevar nash, zakif leh al kol bene alma. veavid leh resha decholla, vechullehu sanoy itkafyayn techotoy.

David malka, sanu leh achoy, dachu leh minnayyhu. kudesha berich hu arim leh al kol bene alma. ata chamoy, arak mikkameh. kudesha berich hu arim leh al kol malchuteh, vechullehu havu karin vesagdin kammeh. veyosef dachu leh achuy, levatar kullehu karu usegidu kammeh. hada hu dichtiv vayyavou ache yosef vayyishtachavu lo appayim artza.
Davar acher, veatta yarum roshi, may veatta, kemo veatta. ribbi yehuda amar, ha ittemar, et deihu darga illaa, uman ihu hahu et. da hei, veikre atta. veatta, da ihu uve dineh.

Yarum roshi, laarama lah bikara umalchuta. al oyvay sevivotay, illen shear malche ara. veezbecha beoholo, da yerushala 40. beoholo, da ohel moed. zivche terua, lemishma kol alma. ashira vaazammera, mehahu sitra ditrua hi. deha mittamman, mehahu sitra ditrua, hi atya shira vetushebachta.

Davar acher, veatta yarum roshi, da keneset yisrael. al oyvay sevivotay, da esav vechol afarchin dileh. veezbecha beoholo, illen yisrael. zivche terua, dichtiv, (Tehillim 51:19) zivche elohim ruach nishbara, begin leaavara dina mealma. ashira vaazammera, leodaa uleshabbecha lekudesha berich hu, bela pesiku leolam.

Davar acher, veatta yarum roshi, becholla, yetzer tov al yetzer ra. dichtiv, al oyvay sevivotay, da yetzer hara, deihu sacharaneh devar nash, veihu saneh becholla. veezbecha veoholo zivche terua, da orayyta, deityehivat missitra deeshsha, kedichtiv (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo. deha begin orayyta, yarum resheh, veittavru kol sanoy kodamoy. kedichtiv, (Tehillim 18:40) tachria kamay tachtay.

Davar acher veatta yarum roshi, leitkelala baavahan, deha david malka, it leh leitdabbaka baavahan, ucheden yitromem vesalik leela, veihu bechad kishshura behu. al oyvay sevivotay, illen inun devistar semala, kullehu mare dinin, demitkavvenin lechabbala. ucheden shimsha itchabbar besihara, vehave kolla chad.

Ta chaze ketiv, veyosef hu hashshallit al haaretz, da shimsha deshallit besihara, venahir lah vezan lah. hu hammashbir lechol am haaretz, deha hahu nahar denagid venafik, minneh itzanu kullehu, umittamman parchin nishmatin lecholla. uvegin da, kullehu sagdin legabbeh dehahu atar, deha let lach milla bealma, dela tale bemazzala veukemuha:

Vayyakker yosef et echav vehem lo hikkiruhu. ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Tehillim 49:6) lamma ira bime ra avon akevay yesubbeni. ta chaze, telat inun dedachalin vela yadin mimma dachalin, veukemuha. aval it man dedachil, vela yada mimma ihu dachil, begin inun chete. dela yada deinun chatain, vela ashgach behu, veihu dachil mime ra.
Man inun yeme ra, illen inun yomin deinun izdammenan behahu
395: Ra. uman inun, (davar acher ihu) da yetzer hara, deihu ikre ra. veit leh yomin yedian, deityehiv leh reshu bealma, leastaa lechol inun dimsaave archayyhu. deman deate leistaava, mesaave leh. veillen inun ikrun yeme ra, veillen memannan al inun chovin dedashin behu beni nasha baakevayyhu.

Ta chaze, kol inun dimsaave archayyhu, kamma chavile tehirin izdammenan legabbayyhu, umesaave lehu. bearcha devae bar nash lemehach, behahu archa medabberin leh mammash. ate bar nash leitdakkaa, kamma inun dimsayyin leh.

Ha taninan, dechad bar nash kam betzafra, bae leaschaa yedoy, miggo (leel 53 1) natla demaya, deihu mana littol minneh maya. miggo man deasche yedoy bekadmita, kema deukemuha. veta chaze, begin natla da, okimna milla.

Vetu, devaya leh levar nash, lenatla yeda yemina bismala. begin leshaltaa yemina al semala, veyisteche yemina min semala, uvegin kach ihu netila. veal da, man denatil yedoy, yittol yemina bismala, leashlata yemina al semala. begin dela yahiv ducheta leyetzer hara leshalletaa kelal, veha okimna.
Ta chaze, beshata dedina bisha shalta, la ativ yedeh milavasha. uveshata dimina shalta al amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot letavra lon, chayis kudesha berich hu alayyhu, vela shatze lon.

Ubbegin kach, kol man deihu chate, beinun chetin dedash behu beragloy, la yada behu, vedachil tedira. david malka hava istamar tadir mechovin illen, vechad hava nafik likrava, hava mefashpesh lon. veal da la dachil laagacha immehon kerava.

Veta chaze, arba malchin havu, man deshail da la shail da. david amar, (Tehillim 18:38) erdof oyvay veassigem velo ashuv ad kallotam. may tama, begin dehava istammar meillen chovin, vela yahiv ducheta lesanoy leshalletaa. veal da bae lemirdaf abbatrayyhu tadir, vela yirdefun inun avatreh lemitba chovoy, veyippol bidayyhu.

Asa hava dachil yattir, af al gav dehava mefashpesh bechetoy, vela chedavid malka. ihu bae lemirdaf abbatrayyhu, vela yaggiach lon, veyiktol lon kudesha berich hu, vechach hava. dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 2 14:12) vayyirdefem asa vehaam asher immo vegomer, uchetiv vayyiggof Adonai et hakkushim lifne asa velifni yehuda vayyanusu hakkushim. (vechen) david ma ketiv beh, (Shmuel 1 30:17) vayyakkem david mehanneshef vead haerev lemochoratam. aval asa ihu radif vekudesha berich hu mache.

Yehoshafat melech yehuda, uf hachi name hava shail. veamar, la yachilna lemirdaf vela lekatla. ella ana azammer, veat ketel lon. begin dela hava mefashpesh kol kach keasa. vekudesha berich hu avad leh hachi. dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 2 20:22) uveet hechellu verina utehilla natan Adonai mearvim al beni ammon moav vehar seir habbaim lihuda vayyinnagefu.

Chizkiyya melech yehuda, uf hachi name amar. ana la yachilna, la lezammara, vela lemirdaf, vela laagacha kerava. begin dedachil meillen chovin dekaamaran. ma ketiv, (Melachim 2 19:35) vayhi valayla hahu vayyetze malach Adonai vayyach bemachani ashshur mea ushemonim vachamishsha elef vayyashkimu vabboker vehinne chullam pegarim metim. vechizkiyya hava yativ beveteh veshachiv bearseh, vekudesha berich hu katil lon.

Uma tzaddikim illen havu dachalin meillen chovin, shear beni alma al achat kamma vechamma. begin kach it leh levar nash leistammera meillen chovin, ulefashpesha behon kidkaamaran. begin dela yishletun aloy inun yeme ra, dela merachame aleh.

Ta chaze, vayyakker yosef et echav. beshata denaflu beyadeh, ihu rachim alayyhu, begin deihu shelim. vehem lo hikkiruhu, deinun shimon velevi, atu missitra dedina kashya, veal da la rechimu aleh. deha kol inun marehon dedina kashya, la merachame alayyhu divne nasha beshata denafle bidayyhu.
Uvegin kach amar david, (Tehillim 49:6) lamma ira. yareti la ketiv, ella ira, (ella) deit (nusach acher delet) li lemidchal
396: Meinun yeme ra, kidkaamaran. avon akevay yesubbeni, man akevay. illen inun beraza dimhemnuta. dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:26) veyado ochezet baakev esav, da hu akeva. veinun akevin demistakkelin behu tadir behahu chova dedash beh bar nash tadir baakevoy.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu Adonai:18) hoy moshche heavon bechavle hashshav vechaavot haagala chattaa. bechavle hashshav, dedash beh baakeva vela chayyish aleh. ulevatar ittakkaf veitavid (bechavle hashsheva) kaavot haagala, veittakkaf hahu cheta. veaste leh behay alma uvealma deate.

Zakkain inun tzaddikayay, deyadin leistammera mechovehon, veinun mefashpeshin tadir beovadayyhu. begin dela yishtakkach alayyhu mekatrega behay alma, vela yistun alayyhu lealma deate. deha orayyta metakna lehu archin ushevilin lemehach behu, dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:17) deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom:

Vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam lahem vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Mishlei 24:17) binfol oyivcha al tismach uvikkashlo al yagel libbecha. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu avad leh levar nash, deyizke likara dileh, uleshammasha kammeh tedira, uleishtaddela beorayyta yemama velele. begin dekudesha berich hu itrae bah beorayyta tadir.

Vechevan devara kudesha berich hu leadam, yahav kammeh orayyta, veolef leh bah leminda archaha. menalan, dichtiv, (Iyov 28:27-28) az raah vaysapperah hchinah vegam chakarah. ulevatar, vayyomer laadam hen yirat Adonai hi chachma vesur mera bina. kevan deistakkal bah vela natir lah, avar al pikkuda demareh veitpas bechoveh.

Vechol inun deavru al milla chada deorayyta, ittefasu vah. shelomo malka deitchakkam al kol bene alma, avar al milla chada deorayyta, vegarim leh leitavara malchuteh minne, uleitpallega malchuta min benoy. man deaavar al orayyta al achat kamma vechamma.

Veyosef dehava yada orayyta, vaachoy naflu bideh, ammay gilgel alayyhu kol gilgula da. veha ihu yada orayyta deolif leh avoy. ella, chas veshalom deyosef gilgel alayyhu gilgulin lenakma minnayyhu. ella kol da la avad, ella leayytaa laachuha binyamin legabbeh, detiuveteh hava legabbe. veihu la shavak laachoy leminpal, deha ketiv, vaytzav yosef vaymalleu et kelehem bar vegomer, vechol da begin dela yinpelun.

Ribbi yehuda amar, kad bera kudesha berich hu lesihara, hava istakkal bah tadir, kedichtiv, (Devarim 11:12) tamid eni Adonai elohecha bah, ashgachuta dileh bah tadir, uchetiv az raah, deha shimsha beashgachuta dileh bah, itnehir. vaysapperah, may vaysapperah, kema deat amer, (Iyov 28:6) mekom sappir avaneha.

Hechinah, deihi yatva betikkuna, bitresar techumin, mitpallega (Shemot 58 2) beshivin kesirin. atkin lah beshiva samchin illain, leitnahara uleyatva al shelimu. vegam chakarah, leashgacha alah tadir, zimna batar zimna, dela pasik lealmin.

Ulevatar azhar leh levar nash, veamar vayyomer laadam hen yirat Adonai hi chachma vesur mera bina. dehay mitattera al tattay, ledachala uleminda leh lekudesha berich hu beginah. vesur mera bina, beriru mippesaluta, dela lemikrav bahadeh. ucheden ashgachuta (nusach acher ashekachevatea) devina, leminda uleistakkela bikara demalka illaa.

Ribbi yose kam belelya chad leishtaddela beorayyta, vehava tamman immeh chad yuday, deoora beh behahu veta. patach ribbi yose veamar, (Mishlei 10:2-3) lo yoilu otzrot resha utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet. lo yoilu otzrot resha, illen inun dela mishtaddele beorayyta, veazle batar mille dealma, ulemichnash otzrin dechiyyuva. ma ketiv, veavad haosher hahu beinyan ra. begin deinun otzrot resha.

Utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet, illen demishtaddele beorayyta, veyadin orchaha leishtaddela (leistakkela) vah. deha orayyta etz chayyim ikre, veitkeriat tzedaka. dichtiv, utzedaka tihye lanu. davar acher, utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet, da tzedaka mammash, uvitren gevavnin ihu, uvitren sitrin. kare beh orayyta,
397: Amar hahu yuday, vekare beh shalom. amar ribbi yose, hachi hu vadday deikre shalom. kam hahu yuday, veishtattaf bahadeh, patach hahu yuday veamar, (Mishlei 28:19) oved admato yisba lachem umeraddef rekim yisba resh. hay kera kashya, vechi shelomo malka deihu chakkim mikkol bene alma, hech amar deyishtaddal bar nash lemiflach ara uleishtaddela avatreh, veyishbok chayye alma.

Ella raza ihu. patach veamar, (Bereshit 2:15) vayyikkach Adonai elohim et haadam vayyannichehu vegan eden leavdah uleshamrah, veukemuha beraza dekarbanin ihu. ta chaze, leavdah, da malka illaa. uleshamrah, da malka tattaa. alma illaa, vealma tattaa. leavdah (didchura) beraza dezachor, uleshamrah beraza deshamor.

Ubbegin kach, oved admato, da gan eden. deitzterich lemebad ulemiflach, uleamshacha lah birchan milleela. vechad itbarcha veitmashshecha lah birchan milleela, ihu name itbarech bahadah. ta chaze, dechahana dimvarech, mitbarech. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 6:27) vaani avarachem. uvegin kach, oved admato yisba lachem, da hu mezona dilela. umeraddef rekim, man deyitdabbak besitra ochora, deihu meraddef rekim. yisba resh vday. amar ribbi yose, zakkaa ant, dezachit lehay milla.

Tu patach veamar kera avatreh, (Mishlei 28:20) ish emunot rav berachot, da hu bar nash dimhemnuta dekudesha berich hu beh, kegon ribbi yesa sava. deaf al gav dehava leh mechla dehahu yoma lemechal, la hava matkin leh ad deshail mezoneh kamme malka kaddisha. levatar detzalle tzeloteh veshail mezoneh kamme malka, keden hava metakkin. vehava amar tadir, la netakkin, ad deyinnatnun mibbe malka.
Veatz lehaashir lo yinnake, begin dela baa leishtaddela beorayyta, deihi chayyin dealma den, vechayyin dealma deate. hasheta deihi shata leishtaddela beorayyta, nishtaddel.

Patach hahu gavra beraza dechelma veamar, vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam lahem vegomer. vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot, vechi yosef ammay (nusach acher amar o) adkar lon inun chalomot dechalam lehu. uma sagya leh illu la adkar lehu, deha yosef chakkim hava, uchetiv, kol arum yaase vedaat uchesil yifros ivvelet.

Aval, kevan dechama deinun attu, vesagde leh appin al ara. keden idkar mimma dechalam lehu, kad hava immehon. dichtiv, vehinne kamma alummati vegam nitztzava vehinne tesubbena alummotechem vattishtachavena laalummati. amar yosef beshata dechama decharin achoy kammeh. dichtiv, vayyavou ache yosef vayyishtachavu lo appayim artza, keden vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam. deha chama dehavu kayyme (mitkayyeymme).

Tu, vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam, adkar lon. begin delet nashyu kamme kudesha berich hu, deha chelma deihu tava, bae var nash leadkara leh dela yitneshe, ucheden itkeyyaym. deha kema deitneshe kammeh devar nash, hachi itneshe aleh.

Ta chaze, chelma dela itpashshar, keiggarta dela mitkarya, veta chaze, begin dela idkar, keman dela yada leh. veal da, man deitneshe minneh chelma vela yada leh, la kayyma aleh leitkayyma. uvegin da yosef hava dachir chelmeh, begin leitkayyeyma. begin dela yitneshe chelma minneh lealam, vehava mechakke leh tadir. vayyomer alehem meraggelim attem, ihu dachir chelma. aval milla la amar lon, ella meraggelim attem.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Kohelet Adonai:2) ki va hachalom berov inyan vekol kesil berov devarim. ki va hachalom berov inyan, ha ukemuha. dechamma inun semichin bechelma, umemannan dargin al dargin. ad dechalmin minhon keshot kullehu, uminnehon deit behon keshot uchedivu. aval leinun zakkae keshot, la itgeli lon millin kedivan kelum, ella kullehu keshot.
Ta chaze, daniyyel ma ketiv beh, (Daniel 2:19) edayin ledaniyyel bechezva di lelya
398: Raza galle. uchetiv, (Daniel 7:1) daniyyel chelem chaza vechezve reshe al mishkeveh bedayin chelma chetav. vei it beh millin kedivan, ammay ichtiv ben ketuvim. ella inun zakkae keshot, beshata denishmathon salkin. la mitchabberan behu, ella millin kaddishin. deodin leh mille dik shot, millin kayyman dela meshakran lealmin.

Vei tema, ha tenan dedavid malka la chama chelma tava. ha ishtema dehava chame david millin dela keshot. ella vadday, kol yomoy hava mishtaddel leoshda damin, veaggach keravin, vechol chelmoy la havu ella chelmin bishin. chureva veshommuta vedama veoshidu dedamin, vela chelma dishlam.

Vei tema, levar nash tav achaziu leh chelma bisha, hachi hu vadday. kol inun bishin dezamminin leitdabbeka al inun deavre al pitgame deorayyta, veinun onashin dezamminin leitanasha behahu alma, kullehu chame. begin dechol shata yehe dechilu demareh aleh, veha itaru. dichtiv, (Kohelet 3:14) vehaelohim asa sheyyiru milfanav, ze chalom ra. veal da, lehahu zakkaa, achaziu leh chelma bisha, kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, deha taninan, dehahu bar nash dechame chelma, bae leh lemiftach pumeh beh kamme bene nasha derachame leh. begin deyistallak reuta dilhon legabbeh letav, veyiftechun pumayyhu letav, veyishtakkach reuta umilla kolla letav. reuta deihi machashava, sheruta decholla, umilla deihi siyyuma decholla. veal da ishtakkach deha shelimu ihu beraza illaa. uvegin kach itkeyyaym kolla, uveinan rechimin devar nash (nusach acher rechimin aleh davar nash begin) leitkayyeyma behahu pishra tava, vecholla ihu kedka yeut.

Ubbegin kach kudesha berich hu oda leh levar nash, kol chad vechad, behahu darga dileh, kema deihu. uvehahu gavvna dechol chad vechad, amar dihe chelma. amar hahu yuday, vadday dechelma lav ihu ella levar nash zakkaa, deihu chama chelma kedka chaze.

Veta chaze, dechad bar nash naim al arseh, nishmateh nafka veshatya bealma leela, vealat beatra dealat. vechamma chavile tehirin, kayymin veazlin bealma, ufagin bah behahi nishmata. i zakkaa hi, salka leela vechamat ma dechamat. vei lav, itachadat behahu sitra, umodiin lah millin kedivan, o millin dezamminin lemete lizman kariv. vechad itar hahi nishmata deveh, ihi moda leh ma dechamat.

Veal da, levar nash delav ihu zakkaa, modiin leh chelma tava delav ihu keshot. kolla begin leastaa leh mehahu orach keshot. kevan deihu aste orcheh meorach keshot, mesaavin leh. dechol man deate leitdakkaa, medakkein leh. uman deate leistaava, mesaavin leh. ha vadday ittemar hachi.

Yatvu ad desalik tzafra, amar ribbi yose, vadday la zachar shemeh deyosef beinun degalim. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 2:18) degel machane efrayim, vela ketiv degel machane yosef. begin deitgae al achoy, veha ittemar.
Amar hahu yuday, vadday shemana deyosef ihu bealma didchura, vechullehu shivtin bealma denukeva inun. veal da la itkelil yosef immehon, begin deihu bealma didchura immehon (nusach acher 33 immehon).

Ma ketiv, kullanu bene ish echad nachnu. nachnu, anachnu mibbae leh. ammay chaser 1. ella, begin deraza divrit la ishtakkach immehon, istallak mittamman 1. deha 1 dechura ihu. veal da 2 ihi nukeva, 1 dechura. uvegin da istallak 1 mittamman, veishtaaru inun nukeve legave shechinta.

Ulevatar amru, kenim anachnu, ittosaf 1. amru vela yade ma kaamru. begin deyosef ishtakkach tamman, veashlimu milla, veamru anachnu. menalan, dichtiv vayyomru shenem asar avadecha achim anachnu, veyosef ihu bechushebana, kad al bechushebana, amru anachnu. vechad la al bechushebana, amru nachnu.
Amar ribbi yose, kol hanne millin dekaamaran hacha, kudesha berich hu itrae behu, deha shechinta
399: La aade mehacha. kedichtiv, (Malachi 3:16) az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vayyikkatev sefer zikkarun lefanav leyire Adonai ulechoshve shemo:

Vayyeesof otam el mishmar sheloshet yamim. amar ribbi elazar, hanne telat yomin ammay. ella hanne telat yomin, lokovel telat yomin dishchem. dichtiv, (Bereshit la) vayhi bayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv beh, vayyomer alehem yosef bayyom hashshelishi zot asu vichyu. leachazaa dela avad ihu, kema deinun avdu vishchem. degarmu leanshe shechem lekabbela alayyhu hay zot, raza divrit. ulevatar deavadu kiyyuma da, katilu lon, vela ishtaar minnehon chad. veihu ma ketiv, zot asu vichyu. may tama, begin deet haelohim ani yare, natir keyayma. vechol gilgula da la hava ella begineh devinyamin:

Vayyomru ish el achiv aval ashemim anachnu al achinu vegomer. vayyomru ish el achiv, da shimon velevi, kema dehava bekadmita. dichtiv, (Bereshit 37:19) vayyomru ish el achiv hinne baal hachalomot hallaze ba. ma lehallan shimon velevi, uf hacha shimon velevi.

Ta chaze, man ish uman achiv. ella ish, da shimon, ketiv hacha ish, uchetiv hatam (Bamidbar 25:6) vehinne ish mibbene yisrael ba. ma lehallan mishshimon, uf hacha name shimon. uvegin deahadar bitshuva, bacha veitnecham al da. veamar lelevi, aval ashemim anachnu. al da itbene mazzaleh shor, kegavvna demazzeleh deyosef shor. dichtiv, (Devarim 33:17) bechor shoro hadar lo, umazzaleh deshimon shor ihu.

Veal da, vayyikkach meittam et shimon, begin dela yekatreg bahadeh delevi. begin deshimon velevi, kad mitchabberan tarvayyhu yachle lekatrega: vayyeesor oto leenehem, ha ukemuha, leenehem asaro. ulevatar denafku hava maachil leh, umashke leh.

Vei tema diruta deyosef ihu, begin dichtiv, (Mishlei 25:21) im raev sonaacha haachilehu lechem veim tzame hashekehu mayim. i hachi, yosef deihu zakkaa, hechi avid hachi. deha ketiv, (Mishlei 25:22) ki gechalim atta chotte al rosho vaAdonai yeshallem lach.

Ella, chas veshalom deyosef lehachi hu dechayish. ella kevar nash leachoy, hachi name hava avid. itnehig immeh beachva, vela begavvna ochora. vela immeh bilchodoy, ella im kol achoy. kema dichtiv, vaytzav yosef vaymalleu et kelehem bar ulehashiv kaspehem ish el sakko velatet lahem tzeda ladderech vayyaas lahem ken, begin leanhaga immehon beachva.

Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Nachum 1:12) im shelemim vechen rabbim vechen nagozu veavar veinniticha lo aannech od, hay kera ukemuha. dechad amma kullehu it behu shelam, vela it behu mare devavu. kudesha berich hu chayis alayyhu, vedina la shalta behu. veaf al gav dechullehu palche lekochavim umazzalot, veinun bishlam, dina la shallit alayyhu, veukemuha. dichtiv, (Hoshea 4:17) chavur atzabbim efrayim hannach lo.

Vechen nagozu veavar, may vechen nagozu, venagozu mibbae leh. ella, da hu resha dikra deihu shelam, uf hacha shelam. umay ihu, da tzedaka. begin ditzdaka da hu shalom, uman deasge bitzdaka, asge shelam leela, veasge shelam letatta. uvegin kach vechen nagozu veavar, degazze mamonhon bitzdaka. veavar, veavru mibbae leh, may veavar. ella da hu dina derugeza, kema deat amer, (yeshaya 26) ad yaavar zaam, avar dina mealayyhu.

Davar acher, ko amar Adonai im shelemim, illen yisrael. dekudesha berich hu yahav lon berit kayyayma lenatra leh tadir, ulemeheve beh bar nash shelim bechol sitrin leela vetatta. vei la natir leh bar nash tadir, ha ihu pagim, pagum becholla. menalan, dichtiv, (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim. may tamim, shelim. dead la itkeyyaym beh berit, ihu pagim.
Uvegin kach, im shelemim vechen rabbim. im shelemim denatre pikkuda da, lemeheve shelemin, dela yehon pegimin, vechen rabbim, yifshun
